-- Read state, issue Run commands. No damage/energy/outcome rules live in this view.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Actors = require("abyss_actor")
local Run = require("abyss_run")
local EnemyView = require('abyss_battle_enemy_view')
local RewardOwner = require("abyss_battle_reward_owner")
local M = {}
local function needsTarget(state, instance)
    -- Ask the core to validate the same card with and without a target.
    local _, reason = Combat.canPlay(state, instance.uid, nil)
    return reason == "invalid_target"
end
-- Explicit ports preserve the approved implementation without a shared constructor closure.
function M.install(owner, ownership, host, _dependencies)
    function owner:setData(nextData, nextPresentation)
        assert(not self.busy, "cannot replace card data during feedback")
        assert(type(nextData)=="table" and type(nextPresentation)=="table", "invalid UI card data")
        self.data, self.presentation = nextData, nextPresentation
        self.selected, self.hover, self.help = nil, nil, nil
    end
    local function child(name)
        local nested=name:match('^potion[45]$') or name:match('^potionHelp%d$') or name=='potionReward' or name=='emeraldKeyReward' or name:match('^relicReward%d$')
        local found=(nested and host.stage:GetChild('potionHelp') or host.stage):GetChild(name)
        return assert(found, "missing UI control " .. name)
    end
    local function show(name, value) child(name):SetVisible(value == true) end
    local function label(name, value) child(name).text = value end
    local function colour(value) return host.platform.color(value.r, value.g, value.b, value.a) end
    local function tint(control, value) control.imageColor = colour(value) end
    local function ink(control, value) control.fontColor = colour(value) end
    local function picture(control, id)
        control:SetImage(host.platform.imageSource, type(id) == "table" and id.id or id)
    end
    local function notice(value)
        label("notice", value)
        owner.rewardNotice = value
    end
    local function rewardScreen(screen)
        if owner.rewardScreen ~= screen then
            owner.rewardScreen, owner.rewardEpoch = screen, (owner.rewardEpoch or 0) + 1
            owner.hover = nil
        end
    end
    local function dragReady(g)
        return owner.active and not owner.busy and owner.run == g.run and owner.run.phase == "combat"
            and owner.run.combat == g.battle and g.battle.phase == "player" and g.battle.turn == g.turn
    end
    local function rewardReady(g)
        return RewardOwner.ready(owner, g)
    end
    local function cardReady(g)
        if not owner.active or owner.busy or owner.run ~= g.run or owner.run.phase ~= g.phase then return false end
        if g.phase == "combat" then
            local instance = g.battle.hand[g.slot]
            return dragReady(g) and instance ~= nil and instance.uid == g.uid
        end
        if g.phase ~= "reward" or owner.rewardScreen ~= "cards" or not rewardReady(g) then return false end
        return Run.rewardOptions(owner.run)[g.slot] == g.uid
    end
    local function cancelCardInputs()
        for _, input in ipairs(ownership.cardInputs) do input.held, input.released = nil, nil end
    end
    local function potionReady(g)
        return dragReady(g) and owner.run.potions == g.inventory
            and owner.run.potions[g.slot] == g.id
    end
    local function cancelPotionInputs()
        for _, input in ipairs(ownership.potionInputs) do input.held, input.released = nil, nil end
    end
    local function cancelPotionAim(message)
        if not owner.potionAim then return false end
        local aim=owner.potionAim
        if aim.moving and aim.input then
            aim.input.held,aim.input.released=nil,nil
            aim.input.consumed={touch=aim.touch}
            -- Explicit command wrappers may clear suppression before rejecting
            -- this invalidated aim. Retain that release's finite origin, while
            -- true stale/resize cancellation barriers remain deliberately true.
            if owner.suppressClick==false then
                ownership.releasedDragTouch,owner.suppressClick=aim.touch,aim
            end
        end
        owner.potionAim = nil
        if message then notice(message) end
        return true
    end
    local function aimReady(aim)
        if not potionReady(aim) then return false end
        if aim.moving and (not aim.input or not aim.input.held or aim.input.held.aim~=aim) then return false end
        local enemies = aim.battle.enemies
        if #enemies ~= #aim.actors then return false end
        for i, actor in ipairs(aim.actors) do
            if enemies[i] ~= actor or Actors.isActive(actor) ~= aim.living[i] then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function actionContextReady(g)
        local run = owner.run
        if not owner.active or owner.busy or owner.gesture or run ~= g.run then return false end
        if run and (run.phase ~= g.phase or run.combat ~= g.battle
            or g.battle and g.battle.turn ~= g.turn) then return false end
        return true
    end
    local function playAreaReady(g)
        if g.aim then return owner.potionAim == g.aim and aimReady(g.aim) end
        local instance = g.battle and g.battle.hand[g.slot or 0]
        return dragReady(g) and instance and instance.uid == g.uid and owner.selected == g.uid
            and owner.selectionEpoch == g.selectionEpoch and not needsTarget(g.battle, instance)
    end
    local function rewardListActionReady(g, rewards)
        local relicIndex=g.name:match('^relicReward(%d)$')
        if relicIndex then
            local item=rewards.relics and rewards.relics[tonumber(relicIndex)]
            return item and not item.claimed and not item.unavailable
        end
        if g.name == "cardReward" then return not rewards.cardResolved end
        if g.name == "goldReward" then return rewards.goldClaimed == false end
        if g.name == 'emeraldKeyReward' then return Run.canClaimEmeraldKey(owner.run) end
        if g.name == "claimPotion" then return rewards.potion and not rewards.potion.resolved end
        if rewards.manualContinue then
            if g.name == "stolenGold" then return rewards.stolenGold and not rewards.stolenGold.claimed end
            if g.name == "continue" then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function rewardActionReady(g, run)
        if not rewardReady(g) then return false end
        if owner.rewardScreen == "cards" then return g.name == "skip" and not run.rewards.cardResolved end
        if owner.rewardScreen ~= "list" then return false end
        return rewardListActionReady(g, run.rewards)
    end
    local function actionReady(g)
        if not actionContextReady(g) then return false end
        local run = owner.run
        if g.name == "start" then return not host.options.embedded and (not run or run.phase == "defeat") end
        if not run then return false end
        if g.name == "playArea" then return playAreaReady(g) end
        if g.name == "endTurn" then return dragReady(g) end
        if run.phase == "reward" then return rewardActionReady(g, run) end
        return g.name == "continue" and not host.options.embedded and run.phase == "map"
    end
    local function cancelActionInputs()
        for _, input in ipairs(ownership.actionInputs) do input.held, input.released = nil, nil end
    end
    local function enemyAt(slot,battle)
        battle=battle or owner.run and owner.run.combat
        return battle and EnemyView.slots(battle)[slot]
    end
    local function sameEnemySlot(slot,actor,battle)
        local entry=enemyAt(slot,battle)
        return entry and entry.actor==actor and entry.id==actor.id
    end
    local function enemyReady(g)
        return not owner.info and dragReady(g) and Actors.isActive(g.actor) and g.battle.enemies[g.slot] == g.actor
            and sameEnemySlot(g.screenSlot,g.actor,g.battle)
            and owner.selected == g.uid and owner.selectionEpoch == g.selectionEpoch
            and owner.potionAim == g.aim and (not g.aim or aimReady(g.aim))
    end
    local function discardEnemyPointer(input,event)
        local touch = event and event.touchId
        if input.held and input.held.touch == touch then input.held = nil end
        if input.released and input.released.touch == touch then input.released = nil end
    end
    -- Click-only controls must not inherit the latest completed drag's named
    -- touch, even after an independent action. A fresh Down retires that origin.
    -- Anonymous origins consume one ambiguous Click without a permanent lock.
    local function consumeReleasedDragClick(event)
        if not owner.active or owner.busy or owner.gesture then return false end
        local touch = event and event.touchId
        if touch ~= nil and touch == ownership.releasedDragTouch then return true end
        local g = owner.suppressClick
        if type(g) ~= 'table' then return false end
        owner.suppressClick = nil
        return g.touch == touch
    end
    return {
        child=child, show=show, label=label, colour=colour, tint=tint,
        ink=ink, picture=picture, notice=notice, rewardScreen=rewardScreen, dragReady=dragReady,
        rewardReady=rewardReady, cardReady=cardReady, cancelCardInputs=cancelCardInputs, potionReady=potionReady, cancelPotionInputs=cancelPotionInputs,

        rewardActionReady=rewardActionReady, actionReady=actionReady, cancelActionInputs=cancelActionInputs, enemyAt=enemyAt, sameEnemySlot=sameEnemySlot,
        enemyReady=enemyReady, discardEnemyPointer=discardEnemyPointer, consumeReleasedDragClick=consumeReleasedDragClick
    }
end
return M

-- Read-only intent projection. Core preview APIs retain all combat arithmetic.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Actors = require("abyss_actor")
local Events = require("abyss_events")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local StatusView = require("abyss_battle_status_view")
local EndingIntent = require('abyss_battle_ending_intent')
local number = require("abyss_numbers").integer
local M = {}
local C = Theme.color
local intentColors = { attack = C.danger, defend = C.block, buff = C.buff, debuff = C.debuff }
local intentLabels = { defend = "防御", buff = "强化", debuff = "削弱", charge = "蓄能", sleep = "沉睡",
    unknown = "未知", stunned = "苏醒", split = "分裂", escape = "逃跑" }
local effectKinds = { damage = "attack", block = "defend", gainStatus = "buff",
    applyStatus = "debuff", makeTempCardInDiscard = "debuff", enemyVampireDamage = "attack",
    enemyHealAll = "buff", enemyStrengthAll = "buff", enemyCleanse = "buff",
    heartStatusDraw='debuff',spireBashDebuff='debuff',heartPainfulStabs='buff',
    enemyRally = 'buff', enemyEncourage = 'buff', enemyTorchSpawn = 'buff', enemyTorchRevive = 'buff',
    enemyBronzeSpawn = 'buff', enemyStasis = 'debuff', writhingParasite='debuff', enemyBurnBoth='debuff', enemyDazedDraw='debuff',awakenedVoid='debuff' }

-- Mixed moves show the first other effect kind in the original icon priority.
function M.intentBadge(intent)
    for _, kind in ipairs({ "debuff", "defend", "buff", "attack" }) do
        if kind ~= intent.kind then
            for _, effect in ipairs(intent.effects or {}) do
                if effectKinds[effect.op] == kind then return kind end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Compact icons share the detail projection; numeric detail glyphs are not intents.
-- Stable threat priority is independent of effect execution order in the core.
function M.icons(face)
    if face.hidden then return {}end
    local found, result = {}, {}
    if face.kind then found[face.kind] = true end
    for _, row in ipairs(face.rows or {}) do
        if type(row.icon) == 'string' and Theme.icon.intent[row.icon] then found[row.icon] = true end
    end
    for _, kind in ipairs({'attack','defend','buff','debuff','charge','sleep','stunned','split','escape','unknown'}) do
        if found[kind] and #result < 3 then result[#result + 1] = kind end
    end
    if #result == 0 then result[1] = 'unknown' end
    return result
end
function M.hidden()
    return {hidden=true,value='',label='意图已隐藏',text='符文圆顶隐藏敌人的下一步行动。',rows={
        {colour=C.textDim,name='意图已隐藏',text='符文圆顶隐藏敌人的下一步行动。'}}}
end

local function special(kind, icon, text, note)
    return { value = "", kind = icon, label = intentLabels[kind], text = text,
        rows = {{ icon = icon, colour = C.textDim, name = intentLabels[kind], text = text, note = note }} }
end

local specialIntents = {
    unknown = function(_,enemy)
        if enemy.ai and enemy.ai.kind=='darkling'then
            local view=special('unknown','unknown','再生：本次行动不攻击，随后准备复生；全部共生暗影同时休眠才会被击败。')
            view.label,view.rows[1].name='再生','再生';return view
        end
        if enemy.ai and enemy.ai.kind=='awakened_one'then
            return special('unknown','unknown','重生：本次行动恢复至300点生命，随后进入第二形态。')
        end
        return special('unknown','unknown','下一步行动未知。')
    end,
    escape = function()
        return special("escape", "unknown", "逃离战场，不返还已窃取的金币。")
    end,
    charge = function()
        return special("charge", "unknown", "本回合不攻击，正在蓄能。", "蓄满后发动攻击")
    end,
    sleep = function()
        return special("sleep", "sleep", "沉睡中，本回合不行动。", "损失生命就会惊醒")
    end,
    stunned = function(_, enemy)
        if enemy.definitionId ~= 'lagavulin' then
            return {value='',kind='unknown',label='昏眩',text='陷入昏眩，本回合不行动。',
                rows={{icon='unknown',colour=C.textDim,name='昏眩',text='陷入昏眩，本回合不行动。'}}}
        end
        return special("stunned", "unknown", "刚被惊醒，本回合不行动。")
    end,
    split = function(state, enemy)
        local children=enemy.ai.splitEnemies
        local child = state.catalog.enemies[children and children[1] or enemy.ai.splitEnemy]
        local names=children and (child.name .. '和' .. state.catalog.enemies[children[2]].name) or ('两只' .. child.name)
        return special("split", "unknown", "分裂为" .. names .. "，各自生命等于分裂时的当前生命。")
    end,
}

local function goneView(state, index)
    local gone = state.enemies[index] and state.enemies[index].escaped and "已逃跑" or "已击败"
    return { value = "", kind = "unknown", label = gone, text = gone, rows = {} }
end

local function newPreview(state, index, intent)
    local preview = Events.frame(state)
    preview.rules,preview.catalog=state.rules,state.catalog
    preview.events = {}
    local soften = state.originalV4 and require("abyss_original_v4").intentReduction(state, index) or 0
    return { state = state, enemy = state.enemies[index], intent = intent, preview = preview,
        copy = preview.enemies[index], player = preview.player, soften = soften, result = {}, rows = {} }
end

local function theft(v)
    local ai = v.enemy.ai
    if not ai or ai.kind ~= "looter" or (v.intent.id ~= ai.mugIntent and v.intent.id ~= ai.lungeIntent) then return end
    local gold = number(ai.stealAmount)
    v.result[#v.result + 1] = "先窃取最多 " .. gold .. " 金币（完全格挡仍会失金）"
    v.rows[#v.rows + 1] = { icon = Theme.icon.gold.id, colour = C.debuff, name = "窃金 " .. gold,
        text = "先窃取你最多 " .. gold .. " 金币", note = "完全格挡仍会失金" }
end

local function attackHits(v, effect)
    local calculation = Combat.intentAttackPreview(v.preview, v.copy, v.player, effect.value)
    local amount = calculation.amount
    local times = effect.times or 1
    local hits, cuts, total, unequal = {}, {}, 0, false
    for hit = 1, times do
        local cut = math.min(amount, v.soften)
        cuts[hit]=cut
        v.soften = v.soften - cut
        hits[hit] = amount - cut
        total = total + hits[hit]
        if hit > 1 and hits[hit] ~= hits[1] then unequal = true end
    end
    return hits, total, unequal, times, calculation, cuts
end

local formulaNames={vigor='活力',double_damage='双倍伤害',pen_nib='钢笔尖',weak='虚弱',
    vulnerable='易伤',stance='姿态',flight='飞行',slow='迟缓',back_attack='背击',truncate='向零取整',binary32='单精度'}
local function decimal(value)return string.format('%.9g',value) end
local function formulaStep(step)
    local value=decimal(step.value)
    if step.kind=='base' then return '基础 '..value end
    if step.kind=='strength' or step.kind=='vigor' then
        return (step.kind=='strength' and '力量' or '活力')..' '..(step.operand>=0 and '+' or '')..decimal(step.operand)..' = '..value
    end
    if step.kind=='round' then return '向下取整且不低于0 = '..value end
    if step.kind=='intangible' then return '无实体 min(当前值, 1) = '..value end
    local operator=step.operand and (' ×'..decimal(step.operand)..' = ') or ' = '
    return (formulaNames[step.kind] or step.kind)..operator..value
end
local function attackFormula(calculation,hits,cuts,times)
    local parts,chunks={},{}
    for _,step in ipairs(calculation.steps)do
        parts[#parts+1]=formulaStep(step)
        if #parts==5 then chunks[#chunks+1]=table.concat(parts,' → ');parts={} end
    end
    if #parts>0 then chunks[#chunks+1]=table.concat(parts,' → ') end
    if times>1 then chunks[1]='每段：'..chunks[1] end
    for i,cut in ipairs(cuts)do if cut>0 then
        chunks[#chunks+1]='第'..i..'段削减：'..number(calculation.amount)..' − '..number(cut)..' = '..number(hits[i])
    end end
    return chunks
end

local function attackFace(hits, times, unequal)
    if unequal then
        local values = {}
        for _, hit in ipairs(hits) do values[#values + 1] = number(hit) end
        return table.concat(values, "+")
    end
    return number(hits[1]) .. (times > 1 and "×" .. times or "")
end

local function attackSentence(face, times, each, unequal, singlePrefix)
    if unequal then return "依次攻击 " .. face .. " 点伤害" end
    if times > 1 then return "攻击 " .. times .. " 次，每次 " .. each .. " 点伤害" end
    return singlePrefix .. each .. " 点伤害"
end

local function attackEffect(v, effect)
    local hits, total, unequal, times, calculation, cuts = attackHits(v, effect)
    local each = number(hits[1])
    local face = attackFace(hits, times, unequal)
    local formula=attackFormula(calculation,hits,cuts,times)
    v.attack = v.attack or face
    v.result[#v.result + 1] = attackSentence(face, times, each, unequal, "攻击造成 ")
    v.rows[#v.rows + 1] = { icon = "attack", colour = C.danger, name = "攻击 " .. face,
        tag = times > 1 and "共 " .. number(total) or nil,
        text = attackSentence(face, times, each, unequal, "造成 "),
        note = formula[1] }
    for i=2,#formula do v.rows[#v.rows+1]={icon='attack',colour=C.danger,name='伤害算式（续）',text=formula[i]} end
end

local function blockEffect(v, effect)
    local master = effect.target == 'automaton'
    local amount = number(Combat.blockAmount(v.state, v.copy, effect.value, effect.fixed or master or effect.target == "random_ally"))
    local ally = effect.target == "random_ally"
    local text = effect.target=='all_allies' and '敌方全体存活单位各获得 '..amount..' 点格挡'
        or master and '使青铜机枢获得 '..amount..' 点格挡'
        or ally and "让一名随机队友获得 " .. amount .. " 点格挡（没有队友时给自己）" or "获得 " .. amount .. " 点格挡"
    v.result[#v.result + 1] = text
    v.rows[#v.rows + 1] = { icon = "defend", colour = C.block, name = "格挡 " .. amount,
        text = text,
        note = ally and "没有队友时给自己" or nil }
end

local function statusSentence(gain, effect, status, size)
    return (gain and "自身" or "使你") .. (effect.value < 0 and "失去 " or "获得 ")
        .. size .. (status.stack == "duration" and " 回合" or " 层") .. status.name
end

local function statusRow(v, effect, gain, status, size, sentence)
    local entry = { id = effect.status, amount = effect.value, temporary = 0, kind = status.kind,
        description = status.description, stack = status.stack }
    local kind = gain and StatusView.statusKind(entry) == "buff" and "buff" or "debuff"
    return { icon = kind, colour = intentColors[kind],
        name = status.name .. " " .. (effect.value < 0 and StatusView.signed(effect.value) or size),
        tag = status.stack == "duration" and "持续 " .. size .. " 回合" or nil,
        text = sentence, note = (StatusView.statusDetail(entry, v.state.rules, v.enemy)) }
end

local function statusEffect(v, effect)
    local gain = effect.op == "gainStatus"
    -- Each copied status passes ApplyPower before later effects read it. Artifact
    -- is spent in order and can reject a status before its addition overflows.
    Actors.applyPower(v.preview, gain and v.copy or v.player, effect.status, effect.value, v.copy)
    local status = assert(v.state.catalog.statuses[effect.status])
    local size = number(math.abs(effect.value))
    local sentence = statusSentence(gain, effect, status, size)
    v.result[#v.result + 1] = sentence
    v.rows[#v.rows + 1] = statusRow(v, effect, gain, status, size, sentence)
end

local function discardEffect(v, effect)
    local value = number(effect.value)
    local name = assert(v.state.catalog.cards[effect.card]).name
    if effect.upgraded or effect.card=='burn' and v.enemy.hexBurnUpgraded then name=name..'+'end
    local text = "将 " .. value .. " 张「" .. name .. "」放入你的弃牌堆"
    v.result[#v.result + 1] = text
    v.rows[#v.rows + 1] = { icon = "debuff", colour = C.debuff, name = "塞入「" .. name .. "」×" .. value, text = text }
end

local function unknownEffect(v)
    v.result[#v.result + 1] = "未知"
    v.rows[#v.rows + 1] = { icon = "unknown", colour = C.textDim, name = "未知", text = "下一步行动未知" }
end

local function burnBothEffect(v)
    local name=assert(v.state.catalog.cards.burn).name
    local text='将 1 张「'..name..'」放入你的抽牌堆，另 1 张放入弃牌堆'
    v.result[#v.result+1]=text
    v.rows[#v.rows+1]={icon='debuff',colour=C.debuff,name='塞入「'..name..'」×2',text=text}
end

local function dazedDrawEffect(v)
    local name=assert(v.state.catalog.cards.dazed).name
    local text='将 2 张「'..name..'」随机放入你的抽牌堆'
    v.result[#v.result+1]=text
    v.rows[#v.rows+1]={icon='debuff',colour=C.debuff,name='塞入「'..name..'」×2',text=text}
end

local function act2Row(v, name, text, kind, note)
    v.result[#v.result+1]=text
    v.rows[#v.rows+1]={icon=kind,colour=intentColors[kind],name=name,text=text,note=note}
end
local function vampireEffect(v,effect)
    attackEffect(v,effect)
    act2Row(v,'吸血','按你实际损失的生命回复自身生命','buff','格挡部分不产生治疗')
end
local function stasisEffect(v)
    act2Row(v,'扣押卡牌','扣押抽牌堆中的一张牌；抽牌堆为空时从弃牌堆选择。击败此浮核后归还，满手时放入弃牌堆',
        'debuff','优先稀有，其次罕见、普通；同稀有度随机选择')
end
local function summonEffect(v,effect)
    local name,text
    if effect.op=='enemyEncourage' then
        name,text='鼓舞','敌方全体存活单位各获得 '..number(effect.value)..' 层力量，其他队友各获得 6 点格挡'
    elseif effect.op=='reptomancerSummon'then name,text='召唤','召唤 1 把浮游蛇刃，补充空位（最多 4 把）'
    elseif effect.op=='enemyRally' then name,text='召唤','召唤最多 2 名随从，补充空位'
    elseif effect.op=='enemyTorchSpawn' then name,text='召唤','召唤 2 名燃炬随从'
    elseif effect.op=='enemyBronzeSpawn' then name,text='召唤','召唤 2 名青铜浮核'
    else name,text='复活','复活已倒下的燃炬随从，存活随从保持原状态' end
    act2Row(v,name,text,'buff')
end
local function groupEffect(v,effect)
    local name,text
    if effect.op=='enemyHealAll' then
        name,text='群体治疗 '..number(effect.value),'敌方全体存活单位各回复最多 '..number(effect.value)..' 点生命'
    elseif effect.op=='enemyStrengthAll' then
        name,text='群体力量 '..number(effect.value),'敌方全体存活单位各获得 '..number(effect.value)..' 层力量'
    else name,text='净化','移除自身全部负面状态及暂时失去力量的状态' end
    act2Row(v,name,text,'buff')
end
local function parasiteEffect(v)
    act2Row(v,'寄生','永久获得一张寄生诅咒；本场战斗的牌堆不加入此牌','debuff','整场战斗只施放一次；御守可阻止获得')
end
local function awakenedVoidEffect(v)
    act2Row(v,'虚空','将1张虚空放入抽牌堆的随机位置','debuff','抽到时失去1点能量；虚无')
end
local function timeEaterEffect(v,effect)
    local name,text
    if effect.kind=='cleanse'then name,text='净化','移除自身所有减益（保留正力量）'
    elseif effect.kind=='removeShackled'then name,text='解除力量恢复','移除暂时失去力量的恢复状态'
    else name,text='加速治疗','回复至 '..number(math.floor(v.enemy.maxHp/2))..' 点生命（行动时确定治疗量）'end
    act2Row(v,name,text,'buff')
end
local function daggerSacrificeEffect(v)
    act2Row(v,'自毁','自毁：攻击后失去等于行动开始时生命的生命值（无视格挡）','debuff')
end
local effects = { daggerSacrifice=daggerSacrificeEffect,reptomancerSummon=summonEffect,timeEater=timeEaterEffect, writhingParasite=parasiteEffect,awakenedVoid=awakenedVoidEffect,damage = attackEffect, damageAll = attackEffect, block = blockEffect,
    enemyBurnBoth=burnBothEffect,enemyDazedDraw=dazedDrawEffect,
    enemyVampireDamage=vampireEffect,enemyStasis=stasisEffect,
    enemyRally=summonEffect,enemyTorchSpawn=summonEffect,enemyTorchRevive=summonEffect,
    enemyEncourage=summonEffect,enemyBronzeSpawn=summonEffect,
    enemyHealAll=groupEffect,enemyStrengthAll=groupEffect,enemyCleanse=groupEffect,
    gainStatus = statusEffect, applyStatus = statusEffect, makeTempCardInDiscard = discardEffect }

local function joinedView(v)
    local intent = v.intent
    return { value = v.attack or (intent.kind == "attack" and "?" or ""), kind = intent.kind, badge = M.intentBadge(intent),
        label = intent.kind ~= "attack" and intentLabels[intent.kind] or nil,
        text = #v.result > 0 and table.concat(v.result, "；") or "下一步行动未知。", rows = v.rows }
end

-- One ordered preview supplies the compact face, joined text and detail rows.
local function visibleIntent(state, index)
    local intent = Combat.intent(state, index)
    if not intent then return goneView(state, index) end
    intent=EndingIntent.project(state,state.enemies[index],intent)
    if state.enemies[index].ai and state.enemies[index].ai.kind=='darkling'and intent.id=='reincarnate'then
        local hp=number(math.floor(state.enemies[index].maxHp/2))
        return {value='',kind='buff',label='复生',text='本次行动回复 '..hp..' 点生命，恢复共生，随后重新选招。',
            rows={{icon='buff',colour=C.buff,name='复生',text='回复 '..hp..' 点生命并恢复共生。'}}}
    end
    local describeSpecial = specialIntents[intent.kind]
    -- Summon retains the source unknown face, but its bounded definition has
    -- a useful Chinese detail row. Do not suppress Awakened/Darkling unknowns.
    if state.enemies[index].ai and state.enemies[index].ai.kind=='reptomancer'and intent.id=='summon'then
        describeSpecial=nil
    end
    if describeSpecial then return describeSpecial(state, state.enemies[index]) end
    local view = newPreview(state, index, intent)
    theft(view)
    for _, effect in ipairs(intent.effects) do
        local describe = effects[effect.op]
        if describe then describe(view,effect)
        elseif not EndingIntent.describe(view,effect)then unknownEffect(view)end
    end
    if view.enemy.ai and view.enemy.ai.kind=='act1_boss' and intent.id=='inferno'then
        act2Row(view,'灼伤强化','升级抽牌堆和弃牌堆中的灼伤，并向弃牌堆加入3张灼伤+','debuff')
    end
    return joinedView(view)
end

function M.intentView(state,index)
    if require('abyss_boss_relics').hidesIntents(state)then return M.hidden()end
    return visibleIntent(state,index)
end

return M

-- Read state, issue Run commands. No damage/energy/outcome rules live in this view.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Actors = require("abyss_actor")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local EnemyView = require('abyss_battle_enemy_view')
local DamageView = require('abyss_battle_damage_view')
local PotionView = require("abyss_battle_potion_view")
local IntentView = require("abyss_battle_intent_view")
local RewardOwner = require("abyss_battle_reward_owner")
local M = {}
local C, L, S = Theme.color, Theme.layout, Theme.space
local intentColors = { attack = C.danger, defend = C.block, buff = C.buff, debuff = C.debuff }
local number = require("abyss_numbers").integer
local potionText = PotionView.potionText
local intentView = IntentView.intentView
local function needsTarget(state, instance)
    -- Ask the core to validate the same card with and without a target.
    local _, reason = Combat.canPlay(state, instance.uid, nil)
    return reason == "invalid_target"
end
-- Explicit ports preserve the approved implementation without a shared constructor closure.
function M.install(owner, ownership, host, dependencies)
    local function pendingCardTarget(frame)
        if not frame.fighting or not owner.selected then return false end
        for _, instance in ipairs(frame.battle.hand) do
            if instance.uid == owner.selected then return needsTarget(frame.battle, instance) end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function potionHighlighted(enemy, index, pendingTarget)
        local aim = owner.potionAim
        if not aim or pendingTarget or not Actors.isActive(enemy) then return false end
        if aim.moving then
            local valid, hovered = dependencies.potionDragTarget(aim)
            return valid and hovered == index
        end
        -- Point selection advertises every legal enemy; a moving bottle locks
        -- only the hovered target through potionDragTarget above.
        return true
    end
    local function enemyHighlighted(frame, enemy, index, pendingTarget)
        local targetable = frame.active and pendingTarget and Combat.canPlay(frame.battle, owner.selected, index)
        if owner.gesture and owner.gesture.moving then
            local valid, hovered = dependencies.dragTarget(owner.gesture)
            targetable = valid and hovered == index
        end
        return targetable == true or potionHighlighted(enemy,index,pendingTarget) or owner.acting == enemy.id
    end
    local function enemyIntentFace(frame, enemy, index)
        if require('abyss_boss_relics').hidesIntents(owner.run)then return IntentView.hidden()end
        local shown = ownership.playbackIntents and ownership.playbackIntents[enemy.id]
        local face = shown and Actors.isActive(enemy) and shown or intentView(frame.battle, index)
        local event = frame.enemyPlayback and owner.feedback.current
        -- Cache the historical starting face, not an already-applied later frame.
        if event and event.kind == "intent" and event.detail.enemy == enemy.id then
            ownership.playbackIntents = ownership.playbackIntents or {}
            ownership.playbackIntents[enemy.id] = face
        elseif not Actors.isActive(enemy) and ownership.playbackIntents then
            ownership.playbackIntents[enemy.id] = nil
        end
        return face
    end
    local function renderEnemyIntent(box, face, portrait)
        if face.hidden then
            for _,name in ipairs({'intentIcon','intentBadge','intentExtra','intent','intentLabel','intentHit'})do
                box:GetChild(name):SetVisible(false)
            end
            box:GetChild('intent').text=''
            return
        end
        local icons = IntentView.icons(face)
        local size = L.intent.size
        local iconY = portrait / 2 + L.intent.portraitGap + size / 2
        local pitch = size * 1.5
        for i, name in ipairs({'intentIcon','intentBadge','intentExtra'}) do
            local control, kind = box:GetChild(name), icons[i]
            control:SetVisible(kind ~= nil)
            control:SetSizeDelta(size, size)
            control:SetAnchoredPosition((i - (#icons + 1) / 2) * pitch, iconY)
            if kind then
                dependencies.picture(control, Theme.icon.intent[kind] or Theme.icon.intent.unknown)
                dependencies.tint(control, intentColors[kind] or C.goldDim)
            end
        end
        local attackLabel = box:GetChild('intent')
        attackLabel.text = face.value or ''
        local attack=icons[1]=='attack' and attackLabel.text~=''
        attackLabel:SetVisible(attack)
        local glyphWidth=utf8.len(attackLabel.text)*L.intent.numberSize
        local textWidth=math.max(L.intent.valueWidth,glyphWidth)
        local left=(1-(#icons+1)/2)*pitch-size/2-S.xs
        local valueY=iconY-size/2+L.intent.numberSize/2-L.statusIcon.gap
        attackLabel:SetAnchoredPosition(left+textWidth/2,valueY)
        attackLabel:SetSizeDelta(textWidth,L.nativeText.lineHeight)
        dependencies.ink(attackLabel, C.text)
        box:GetChild('intentLabel'):SetVisible(false)
        local span=#icons*pitch-size/2
        local x0,x1=-span/2,span/2
        local y0,y1=iconY-size/2,iconY+size/2
        if attack then
            x0,x1=math.min(x0,left),math.max(x1,left+glyphWidth)
            y0=math.min(y0,valueY-L.intent.numberSize/2)
        end
        local width,height=math.max(L.statusIcon.minimumTouch,x1-x0),math.max(L.statusIcon.minimumTouch,y1-y0)
        box:GetChild('intentHit'):SetAnchoredPosition((x0+x1)/2,(y0+y1)/2)
        box:GetChild('intentHit'):SetSizeDelta(width,height)
    end
    local function enemyAimProjection(frame)
        local aimed = owner.gesture or owner.carry
        local projection = { pendingTarget = pendingCardTarget(frame) }
        if aimed and aimed.moving then projection.valid, projection.target = dependencies.dragTarget(aimed) end
        if projection.valid then projection.losses = DamageView.preview(frame.battle, aimed.uid, projection.target) end
        local potion=owner.potionAim
        if potion and potion.moving then
            projection.valid,projection.target=dependencies.potionDragTarget(potion)
            if projection.valid then projection.losses=DamageView.potionPreview(owner.run,potion.slot,projection.target) end
        end
        return projection
    end
    local function renderDamagePreview(box, enemy, portrait, width, loss)
        local preview = box:GetChild('damagePreview')
        preview:SetVisible(loss ~= nil and loss.loss > 0)
        preview:SetAnchoredPosition(0, -portrait / 2 - S.xxl + L.nativeText.lineHeight)
        preview:SetSizeDelta(width, L.nativeText.lineHeight)
        preview.text = loss and loss.loss > 0 and (loss.hp <= 0 and '击杀' or '−' .. number(loss.loss)) or ''
        if loss and loss.loss > 0 then box:GetChild('hpFill').fillAmount = math.max(0, loss.hp / enemy.maxHp) end
    end
    local function enemyPortraitIcon(enemy)
        return Theme.icon.enemy[enemy.definitionId] or Theme.icon.node[enemy.tier == 'normal' and 'combat' or enemy.tier]
    end
    local function renderEnemySlot(frame, box, entry, slot, count, aim)
        local enemy = entry.actor
        local x, width, portrait, step, y = dependencies.enemySlot(count, slot, enemy)
        box:SetAnchoredPosition(x, y)
        local selected = enemyHighlighted(frame, enemy, entry.index, aim.pendingTarget)
        local loss = aim.losses and aim.losses[entry.index]
        if aim.valid and not aim.target and loss and loss.loss > 0 then selected = true end
        host.unit(box, enemy, portrait, enemyPortraitIcon(enemy), width, selected,step)
        local dim = (aim.pendingTarget or owner.potionAim ~= nil) and not selected
        local portraitTone = C.text
        local tone={r=portraitTone.r,g=portraitTone.g,b=portraitTone.b,a=dim and 102 or 255}
        dependencies.tint(box:GetChild('portrait'),tone)
        host.monsterArt:write(box,x,y,portrait,tone)
        renderDamagePreview(box, enemy, portrait, width, loss)
        renderEnemyIntent(box, enemyIntentFace(frame, enemy, entry.index), portrait)
    end
    local function renderEnemies(frame)
        local rows = frame.fighting and EnemyView.slots(frame.battle, owner.busy and owner.feedback or nil) or {}
        owner.feedback.enemyRows = rows
        local aim = enemyAimProjection(frame)
        -- Reset old slot owners before registering the new shared portrait owner.
        for i = 1, 5 do owner.feedback.bindEnemySlot(i, rows[i] and rows[i].id) end
        host.monsterArt:select(owner.active and rows or {})
        for i = 1, 5 do
            local box, entry = dependencies.child('enemy' .. i), rows[i]
            box:SetVisible(entry ~= nil)
            if entry then renderEnemySlot(frame, box, entry, i, #rows, aim) end
        end
    end
    local function renderDetails(frame)
        local reward=owner.info and owner.info.reward and RewardOwner.ready(owner,owner.info.reward)
        if owner.info and (not owner.active or owner.busy or owner.gesture or not frame.fighting and not reward
            or owner.info.battle ~= frame.run.combat) then owner.info = nil end
        host.renderInfo(frame.battle or reward and frame.run.combat)
    end
    local function renderRewardActions(frame)
        local run, stolen = frame.run, frame.stolen
        dependencies.button("skip", owner.active and frame.picking == true and not run.rewards.cardResolved and not owner.busy, false, "跳过")
        dependencies.button("stolenGold", owner.active and stolen and not stolen.claimed and not owner.busy, false,
            stolen and (stolen.claimed and "已取回失金 " or "取回失金 ") .. number(stolen.amount) or "取回失金")
    end
    local function renderContinue(frame)
        local run = frame.run
        dependencies.button("continue", owner.active and run and (frame.manual or run.phase == "map") and not owner.busy, true,
            frame.manual and "前往地图" or "再战一场")
    end
    local function bindPotionSlots(frame)
        if frame.fighting and not owner.busy then
            owner.potionBattle, owner.potionRun, owner.potionSlots = frame.battle, frame.run, {}
            for slot = 1, frame.potionCapacity do
                local id = frame.run.potions[slot]
                if id then owner.potionSlots[slot] = {slot = slot, id = id} end
            end
        end
    end
    local function boundPotion(frame, index)
        local binding = owner.potionSlots and owner.potionSlots[index]
        local item = binding and frame.potions[binding.slot]
        if item and item.id ~= binding.id then return nil end
        return item
    end
    local function potionSelected(slot)
        return owner.potionMenu and owner.potionMenu.slot==slot
            or owner.potionAim and owner.potionAim.slot==slot
    end
    local function paintPotionShell(slot,item)
        local selected=item~=nil and potionSelected(slot)==true
        local tones=C.potionShell
        for _,state in ipairs({'normal','hover','pressed','disabled'})do
            local face=dependencies.child('potion'..slot):GetChild(state)
            face:GetChild('emptyShell'):SetVisible(item==nil)
            face:GetChild('filledShell'):SetVisible(item~=nil and item.id~='fire_potion')
            face:GetChild('fireShell'):SetVisible(item~=nil and item.id=='fire_potion')
            face:GetChild('selectedShell'):SetVisible(selected)
            dependencies.tint(face:GetChild('filledShell'):GetChild('rim'),selected and tones.selected.border or tones.normal.border)
            dependencies.tint(face:GetChild('fireShell'):GetChild('rim'),selected and tones.selected.border or tones.fire.border)
            local bottle=face:GetChild('bottle');bottle:SetVisible(item~=nil)
            if item then
                dependencies.picture(bottle,Theme.icon.potion[item.id] or Theme.icon.intent.unknown)
                dependencies.tint(bottle,item.id=='fire_potion' and tones.fire.ink or tones.normal.ink)
            end
        end
    end
    local function renderPotions(frame)
        -- Fixed physical slots prevent a queued second click moving to another item.
        bindPotionSlots(frame)
        for i = 1, L.battlePotions.count do
            local visible = frame.fighting and i <= frame.potionCapacity
            dependencies.show("potion" .. i, visible)
            local item = boundPotion(frame, i)
            dependencies.button("potion" .. i, visible and frame.active and item ~= nil, false,
                item and potionText(item, frame.battle) or "空药水槽")
            dependencies.show("potionHelp" .. i, false)
            dependencies.button("potionHelp" .. i, visible and frame.active and item ~= nil, false, "")
            paintPotionShell(i,item)
        end
    end

    return {
        pendingCardTarget=pendingCardTarget, enemyHighlighted=enemyHighlighted, enemyIntentFace=enemyIntentFace, renderEnemyIntent=renderEnemyIntent, enemyAimProjection=enemyAimProjection,
        renderDamagePreview=renderDamagePreview, enemyPortraitIcon=enemyPortraitIcon, renderEnemySlot=renderEnemySlot, renderEnemies=renderEnemies, renderDetails=renderDetails,
        renderRewardActions=renderRewardActions, renderContinue=renderContinue, bindPotionSlots=bindPotionSlots, boundPotion=boundPotion, renderPotions=renderPotions,
        potionSelected=potionSelected, paintPotionShell=paintPotionShell
    }
end
return M

-- Read state, issue Run commands. No damage/energy/outcome rules live in this view.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Actors = require("abyss_actor")
local Controller = require("abyss_controller")
local M = {}
local function needsTarget(state, instance)
    -- Ask the core to validate the same card with and without a target.
    local _, reason = Combat.canPlay(state, instance.uid, nil)
    return reason == "invalid_target"
end
-- Explicit ports preserve the approved implementation without a shared constructor closure.
function M.install(owner, ownership, host, dependencies)
    local function bindEnemyControls()
        for i = 1, 5 do
            local screenSlot, control, input = i, dependencies.child("enemy" .. i):GetChild("hit"), {}
            ownership.enemyInputs[i] = input
            local function chooseEnemy()
            local entry=dependencies.enemyAt(screenSlot)
            if not entry then return false end
            local target=entry.index
            if owner.potionAim then
                local slot = owner.potionAim.slot
                owner.target = target
                return owner:commitPotion(slot, target)
            end
            if owner.active and owner.run and not owner.busy and owner.run.phase == "combat" and owner.run.combat.enemies[target] and Actors.isActive(owner.run.combat.enemies[target]) then
                owner.target = target
                local selected
                for _, instance in ipairs(owner.run.combat.hand) do
                    if instance.uid == owner.selected then selected = instance break end
                end
                if selected and needsTarget(owner.run.combat, selected) then owner:playSelected(target)
                else
                    owner:showStatus(target)
                end
            end
            end
            Controller.bind(host.controller,control,function()
                local selected
                if owner.run and owner.run.combat then
                    for _,card in ipairs(owner.run.combat.hand)do if card.uid==owner.selected then selected=card end end
                end
                return (owner.potionAim or selected and needsTarget(owner.run.combat,selected)) and "aim" or "battle"
            end,function()owner.suppressClick=false;return chooseEnemy()end,function()
                local entry=dependencies.enemyAt(screenSlot)
                return dependencies.controllerReady() and owner.run.phase=="combat" and entry and Actors.isActive(entry.actor)
            end,screenSlot,"enemies",function()
                local entry=dependencies.enemyAt(screenSlot)
                if entry then owner.target=entry.index;owner:render()end
            end)
            control:AddCursorEventListener(host.clickEvent, function(event)
                if Controller.pointerBlocked(host.controller)then return false end
                if dependencies.swallowed(event) then
                    -- Dismissal consumes this pointer too, but cannot consume a
                    -- newer token owned by a different touch on the same actor.
                    dependencies.discardEnemyPointer(input,event)
                    return
                end
                if ownership.enemyPointerObserved then
                    -- Existing enemy hosts may send Down/Click without Up. Both
                    -- forms consume the same actor-bound, one-shot ownership.
                    local released = input.released or input.held
                    if not released or released.touch ~= (event and event.touchId) then return end
                    input.held, input.released = nil, nil
                    if not dependencies.enemyReady(released) then return end
                end
                if not dependencies.consumeReleasedDragClick(event) and not owner.suppressClick and not owner.gesture then return chooseEnemy() end
            end)
            if owner.dragEnabled then
                control:AddCursorEventListener(host.cursor.CursorDown, function(event)
                    ownership.enemyPointerObserved = true
                    local dismissed = dependencies.down(event)
                    input.held, input.released = nil, nil
                    if dismissed then return end
                    local run, battle = owner.run, owner.run and owner.run.combat
                    local entry=dependencies.enemyAt(screenSlot,battle)
                    local actor=entry and entry.actor
                    if not actor then return end
                    local g = {slot=entry.index,screenSlot=screenSlot, actor=actor, run=run, battle=battle,
                        uid=owner.selected, selectionEpoch=owner.selectionEpoch,aim=owner.potionAim,
                        turn=battle.turn, touch=event and event.touchId}
                    if dependencies.enemyReady(g) then input.held = g end
                end)
                local function releaseEnemy(event, ended)
                    ownership.enemyPointerObserved = true
                    local touch, held = event and event.touchId, input.held
                    if held and held.touch == touch then
                        input.held = nil
                        input.released = not ended and dependencies.enemyReady(held) and held or nil
                        if ended and dependencies.cancelPotionAim("已取消药水瞄准。") then owner:render() end
                    elseif ended and input.released and input.released.touch == touch then
                        input.released = nil
                        if dependencies.cancelPotionAim("已取消药水瞄准。") then owner:render() end
                    end
                end
                control:AddCursorEventListener(host.cursor.CursorUp, releaseEnemy)
                control:AddCursorEventListener(host.cursor.CursorEndDrag, function(event) releaseEnemy(event, true) end)
            end
        end
    end
    local function helpActorReady(token,run)
        local spec=token.spec
        local actor=spec.index==0 and run.combat.player or run.combat.enemies[spec.index]
        return actor==token.actor and Actors.isPresent(token.actor)
            and (not spec.screenSlot or dependencies.sameEnemySlot(spec.screenSlot,token.actor,run.combat))
    end
    return {
        bindEnemyControls=bindEnemyControls, helpActorReady=helpActorReady
    }
end
return M

-- Read state, issue Run commands. No damage/energy/outcome rules live in this view.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Actors = require("abyss_actor")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local CardInput = require("abyss_card_input")
local EnemyView = require('abyss_battle_enemy_view')
local M = {}
local L = Theme.layout
-- Explicit ports preserve the approved implementation without a shared constructor closure.
function M.install(owner, _ownership, _host, dependencies)
    local D = L.cardDrag
    local function enemySlot(count, i, enemy)
        return EnemyView.position(count, i, enemy)
    end
    local function enemyPosition(battle,index)
        local entry,slot,count=EnemyView.find(battle,index,owner.busy and battle==owner.displayBattle and owner.feedback or nil)
        assert(entry,'enemy has no visible presentation slot')
        return enemySlot(count,slot,entry.actor)
    end
    local function dragPose(g)
        return g.x, g.y + (g.touchScreen and 270*g.sourceScale or 0)
    end
    local function inPlayArea(x,y)
        local area = D.playArea
        return math.abs(x-area[1]) <= area[3]/2 and math.abs(y-area[2]) <= area[4]/2
    end
    local function dragTarget(g)
        if not dependencies.dragReady(g) then return false end
        local battle = g.battle
        local ok, reason = Combat.canPlay(battle,g.uid,nil)
        if not ok and reason ~= "invalid_target" then return false end
        local hovered
        local rows = EnemyView.slots(battle)
        local count = #rows
        for i, entry in ipairs(rows) do
            local enemy = entry.actor
            local x, _, portrait, step, y = enemySlot(count,i,enemy)
            local reach = math.min(D.targetColumn,count > 1 and step or D.targetColumn)/2
            if math.abs(g.x-x) <= math.min(reach,portrait/2+D.reticlePad)
                and math.abs(g.y-y) <= portrait/2+D.reticlePad
                and Actors.isActive(enemy) then
                hovered = entry.index; break
            end
        end
        CardInput.sample(g, g.x, g.y, hovered, not ok)
        if g.cancelled then return false, nil, g.aiming end
        if ok then return g.dropZone, nil end
        return g.aiming and hovered ~= nil and Combat.canPlay(battle,g.uid,hovered) or false, hovered, g.aiming
    end
    local function potionDragTarget(aim)
        if not dependencies.aimReady(aim) or not aim.x or not aim.y then return false,nil,true end
        if math.abs(aim.x)>Theme.canvas.base[1]/2 or math.abs(aim.y)>Theme.canvas.base[2]/2 then return false,nil,true end
        local rows=EnemyView.slots(aim.battle)
        for i,entry in ipairs(rows)do
            local x,_,portrait,step,y=enemySlot(#rows,i,entry.actor)
            local reach=math.min(D.targetColumn,#rows>1 and step or D.targetColumn)/2
            if Actors.isActive(entry.actor) and math.abs(aim.x-x)<=math.min(reach,portrait/2+D.reticlePad)
                and math.abs(aim.y-y)<=portrait/2+D.reticlePad then
                return true,entry.index,true
            end
        end
        return false,nil,true
    end
    return {
        enemySlot=enemySlot, enemyPosition=enemyPosition, dragPose=dragPose, inPlayArea=inPlayArea, dragTarget=dragTarget,
        potionDragTarget=potionDragTarget
    }
end
return M

        "aimReady", "cancelPotionAim", "notice", "rewardScreen", "cancelActionInputs"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_card_gestures").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "closeInfo", "cardReady", "dragTarget", "notice", "cancelCardInputs",
        "cancelActionInputs", "cancelPotionInputs", "cancelPotionAim", "refresh", "rewardScreen",
        "movePotion", "releasePotionDrag"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_action_bindings").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "swallowed", "cardReady", "down", "point", "inPlayArea",
        "child", "controllerReady", "actionReady", "consumeReleasedDragClick"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_potion_bindings").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "potionBinding", "cancelPotionAim", "cancelCardInputs", "cancelActionInputs", "refresh",
        "child", "controllerReady", "swallowed", "potionReady", "down", "consumeReleasedDragClick",
        "point", "beginPotionAim", "potionDragTarget"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_card_bindings").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "point", "child", "controllerReady", "listen", "retireInterruptedPress",
        "down", "cancelPotionAim", "move", "release"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_target_bindings").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "child", "enemyAt", "controllerReady", "swallowed", "discardEnemyPointer",
        "enemyReady", "down", "cancelPotionAim", "sameEnemySlot", "consumeReleasedDragClick"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_detail_bindings").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "enemyAt", "listen", "child", "closeInfo", "controllerReady",
        "helpActorReady", "swallowed", "down"
    })))
    connect(links, services)
    -- Runtime bindings keep only their own ports, not the construction registry.
    services = {
        picture=services.picture, tint=services.tint, ink=services.ink, child=services.child, enemyPosition=services.enemyPosition,
        describeInfo=services.describeInfo, show=services.show, placeCard=services.placeCard, placeReward=services.placeReward, dragTarget=services.dragTarget,
        dragPose=services.dragPose, notice=services.notice, refresh=services.refresh, bind=services.bind, cancelPotionAim=services.cancelPotionAim,
        rewardScreen=services.rewardScreen, bindPotionControls=services.bindPotionControls, bindCardControls=services.bindCardControls, bindEnemyControls=services.bindEnemyControls, bindDetailControls=services.bindDetailControls,
        potionDragTarget=services.potionDragTarget,
        cancelCardInputs=services.cancelCardInputs, consumeReleasedDragClick=services.consumeReleasedDragClick
    }
    host.stage = host.options.embedded and host.root or assert(host.root:GetChild("stage"), "missing stage")
    host.cursor = host.platform.cursorEvents
    self.dragEnabled = host.cursor and host.cursor.CursorDown and host.cursor.CursorDrag and host.cursor.CursorUp and host.cursor.CursorEndDrag
    self.instructions = self.dragEnabled and "拖到战场出牌区域松手，目标牌拖向敌人；再点原牌取消。"
        or "点选卡牌，再点敌人或战场出牌区域；再点原牌取消。"
    -- A card click is the final event of one physical pointer sequence. Retain
    -- its original rule identity, not a global permission another Down can reset.
    ownership.cardInputs, ownership.pointerObserved, ownership.releasedDragTouch = {}, false, nil
    -- Potion controls may be click-only even when cards receive pointer events.
    -- Once a potion Down is observed, require its own one-shot release token.
    ownership.potionInputs, ownership.potionPointerObserved = {}, false
    -- Action buttons have their own pointer capability: some hosts deliver
    -- card/potion pointers but only Click for these preset buttons.
    ownership.actionInputs, ownership.actionPointerObserved, ownership.fieldPointerObserved = {}, false, false
    -- Dynamic spawns can occupy an old enemy slot. Pointer ownership follows
    -- the actor object, battle and turn, never a reusable numeric slot alone.
    ownership.enemyInputs, ownership.enemyPointerObserved = {}, false
    -- Source PC behavior: the card center follows the pointer, not the grab offset.
    -- Target cards require an explicit enemy hit, including a little touch padding.
    -- Open ground never substitutes the nearest enemy, even when only one remains.
    host.monsterArt=require('abyss_monster_art').new(host.stage,host.platform)
    host.unit = UnitView.new(services.picture, services.tint, services.ink, statusKind)
    host.lines = InfoContent.lines
    host.infoContent = InfoContent.new(self, {
        statusDetail = statusDetail, statusKind = statusKind, intentView = intentView, potionText = potionText,
        temporaryOps = temporaryOps, stanceNames = stanceNames, orbNames = orbNames,
        kindNames = kindNames, intentColors = intentColors,
    }, host.lines)
    host.paginate = InfoView.paginator(host.lines)
    host.renderInfo = InfoView.new(self, services.child, services.enemyPosition, services.describeInfo, host.paginate, services.tint, services.ink, services.picture)
    -- index 0 is the hero. Opening the same unit again closes it.
    -- Post-battle pick: centred cards on their own stage, never the hand arc.
    -- Hover/press only changes scale and a small lift, so a card's edge stays
    -- under the pointer and neighbours never overlap (step > hover width).
    host.cardView = CardView.new(self, {
        child = services.child, show = services.show, ink = services.ink, tint = services.tint, picture = services.picture, platform = host.platform,
        placeCard = services.placeCard, placeReward = services.placeReward,
        dragTarget = services.dragTarget, dragPose = services.dragPose, enemyPosition = services.enemyPosition,
        potionTarget = services.potionDragTarget,
    })
    self.feedback = Feedback.new(host.stage, host.platform, function(battle, acting)
        self.displayBattle, self.acting = battle, acting
        self:render()
    end, function(failure)
        self.busy, self.displayBattle, self.acting = false, nil, nil
        ownership.playbackIntents = nil
        if self.feedbackRun == self.run and self.feedbackBattle == (self.run and self.run.combat)
            and #self.feedbackBattle.events == self.feedbackLast then
            -- UI is the event consumer. Release consumed frames; the event table identity stays stable.
            for i = #self.feedbackBattle.events, 1, -1 do self.feedbackBattle.events[i] = nil end
        end
        services.notice(failure and "演出已恢复，可继续行动。" or "")
        services.refresh(failure ~= "cancelled")
    end)
    -- An open detail panel owns the next pointer sequence: its Down closes the panel and
    -- the matching Click is swallowed, so no card, target or button acts underneath it.
    host.controller=host.platform.controller
    services.bind("start", function() if not self.run or self.run.phase == "defeat" then self:start() end end)
    services.bind("endTurn", function() self:endTurn() end)
    services.bind("playArea", function()
        if services.cancelPotionAim("已取消药水瞄准。") then services.refresh() return end
        local battle = self.run and self.run.phase == "combat" and self.run.combat
        if not battle then return end
        for _,instance in ipairs(battle.hand) do
            if instance.uid == self.selected and not needsTarget(battle,instance) then self:playSelected(nil) return end
        end
    end)
    services.bind("skip", function()
        if not self.active or not self.run or self.busy or self.run.phase ~= "reward" or self.rewardScreen ~= "cards" then return end
        -- PC SkipCardButton closes the picker; the unclaimed CARD row remains.
        services.rewardScreen("list")
        services.notice("")
        services.refresh()
    end)
    services.bind("cardReward", function()
        if not self.active or self.busy or not self.run or self.run.phase ~= "reward"
            or self.rewardScreen ~= "list" or self.run.rewards.cardResolved then return end
        local Cards=require('abyss_relic_card_rewards')
        if Cards.managed(self.run)then
            local ok=Cards.open(self.run,self.rewardOwner)
            if ok then services.notice('');services.refresh(true)end
            return ok
        end
        services.rewardScreen("cards")
        services.notice("")
        services.refresh()
    end)
    services.bind("goldReward", function()
        if not self.active or self.busy or self.rewardScreen ~= "list" or not self.run then return end
        local ok = Run.claimGoldReward(self.run)
        if ok then services.notice("金币已领取。") services.refresh(true) end
    end)
    services.bind('emeraldKeyReward',function()
        if not self.active or self.busy or self.rewardScreen~='list' or not self.run then return false end
        local ok,why=Run.claimEmeraldKey(self.run)
        if ok then services.notice('已获得绿钥匙。');services.refresh(true)end
        return ok,why
    end)
    for i=1,2 do
        local slot=i
        services.bind('relicReward'..slot,function()
            if not self.active or self.busy or self.rewardScreen~='list' or not self.run then return false end
            local ok,why=Run.claimRelicReward(self.run,slot)
            if ok then services.notice('已获得遗物。');services.refresh(true)end
            return ok,why
        end)
    end
    services.bind("claimPotion", function() return self:claimPotionReward() end)
    services.bind("stolenGold", function()
        if self.active and self.run and not self.busy and self.rewardScreen == "list"
            and Run.claimStolenGoldReward(self.run) then services.notice("已取回失金。") services.refresh(true) end
    end)
    services.bind("continue", function()
        if not self.active or self.busy or not self.run then return end
        if self.run.phase == "reward" then
            if self.rewardScreen ~= "list" then return end
            local ok,reason=Run.leaveCombatRewards(self.run)
            if not ok then services.notice(reasons[reason] or "当前无法离开奖励。") end
            services.refresh(ok)
        elseif not host.options.embedded and self.run.phase == "map" then assert(Run.startCombat(self.run, "cultist_solo")) services.refresh(true) end
    end)
    host.potionPopup=PotionPopup.new(host.stage:GetChild('potionHelp'):GetChild('potionPopup'),self,host.platform,host.clickEvent,{
        pointerDown=function(event)
            if self.active and not self.busy and not self.gesture then
                if event and event.touchId==ownership.releasedDragTouch then ownership.releasedDragTouch=nil end
                self.suppressClick=false
            end
        end,
        pointerClick=function(event)
            return not services.consumeReleasedDragClick(event) and not self.suppressClick and not self.gesture
        end,
        item=function(slot)return Run.potionView(self.run)[slot]end,
        text=function(item,battle)return potionText(item,battle,true):match("\n(.*)") or ''end,
        use=function(slot)return self:usePotion(slot)end,
        discard=function(slot)
            local ok,reason=Run.discardPotion(self.run,slot)
            if ok then self.potionSlots[slot]=nil end
            services.notice(ok and '已丢弃药水。' or reasons[reason] or '当前不能丢弃此药水。')
            services.refresh();return ok,reason
        end,
        changed=function()services.refresh()end,
    })
    services.bindPotionControls()
    services.bindCardControls()
    services.bindEnemyControls()
    services.bindDetailControls()
    for _,kind in ipairs({'draw','discard','exhaust'})do
        local hit=services.child(kind..'Icon'):GetChild('hit')
        local function available()
            return host.options.onPile~=nil and self.active and not self.busy and not self.gesture and not self.carry
                and self.run and self.run.phase=='combat' and self.run.combat.phase=='player'
        end
        local function openPile()
            if available()then return host.options.onPile(kind)end
            return false
        end
        hit:AddCursorEventListener(host.clickEvent,function()
            if Controller.pointerBlocked(host.controller)then return false end
            return openPile()
        end)
        Controller.bind(host.controller,hit,'battle',openPile,available,80)
    end
    local keys = host.platform.keyEvents
    if keys and keys.KeyboardSprintKeyDown and host.root.AddKeyEventListener then
        -- The official UI maps SprintKey to the user's right-mouse binding.
        host.root:AddKeyEventListener(keys.KeyboardSprintKeyDown, function()
            if not self.active or not (self.gesture or self.carry or self.selected) then return false end
            services.cancelCardInputs()
            self.gesture,self.carry,self.selected,self.hover = nil,nil,nil,nil
            self.suppressClick = true
            self:render()
            return true
        end)
    end
    services.refresh()
    return self
end
return M

-- Unit presentation only; status entries and all combat values come from the core.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local number = require("abyss_numbers").integer
local M = {}
local C, L, S = Theme.color, Theme.layout, Theme.space

function M.geometry(portrait,player)
    local g=L.battleUnit
    local foot=portrait/2+(player and g.heroFoot or 0)
    local gap=player and g.heroNameGap or g.nameGap
    local line=player and g.heroNameLine or g.nameLine
    local healthGap=player and g.heroHealthGap or g.healthGap
    local healthRow=player and L.hpBar.size[2] or g.healthRow
    local healthY=-foot-gap-line-healthGap-healthRow/2
    return {nameY=-foot-gap-line/2,healthY=healthY,
        healthWidth=player and g.heroHealthWidth or L.hpBar.size[1],
        firstStatusY=healthY-healthRow/2-g.statusGap-L.statusIcon.size/2}
end

-- Native text rectangles must stay 40 high but are transparent. Only visible
-- glyph height and the actual status touch surfaces contribute to clearance.
function M.noticeLift(actor,portrait,baseY,player)
    local entries,si=Combat.statusView(actor),L.statusIcon
    local g=M.geometry(portrait,player)
    local lower=math.min(-portrait/2,g.nameY-Theme.font.label/2,g.healthY-Theme.font.small/2)
    if actor.block>0 then lower=math.min(lower,g.healthY-math.max(L.blockBadge.size,Theme.font.body)/2) end
    if #entries>0 then
        local lines=math.ceil(math.min(#entries,si.perRow*si.rows)/si.perRow)
        local finalY=g.firstStatusY-(lines-1)*(si.size+si.gap)
        lower=math.min(lower,finalY-si.minimumTouch/2,finalY+L.battleUnit.badgeOffset[2]-Theme.font.small/2)
    end
    local top=L.battleNotice.bandTop
    return math.max(0,top-baseY-lower),lower,top
end

function M.new(picture, tint, ink, statusKind)
    local function portraitParts(box, actor, portrait, icon, width, selected, targetWidth)
        for _, name in ipairs({"plate", "border", "portrait"}) do
            local delta = name == "border" and S.border * 2 or 0
            box:GetChild(name):SetSizeDelta(portrait + delta, portrait + delta)
        end
        box:GetChild("plate"):SetVisible(false)
        box:GetChild("border"):SetVisible(false)
        box:GetChild("hit"):SetSizeDelta(math.min(portrait,targetWidth or portrait),portrait)
        box:GetChild("impact"):SetSizeDelta(portrait, portrait)
        box:GetChild("shield"):SetSizeDelta(portrait, portrait)
        box:GetChild("floating"):SetSizeDelta(width + S.xl, L.nativeText.lineHeight * 2)
        picture(box:GetChild("portrait"), type(icon)=='table' and icon.id or icon)
        -- The traveler bust must stay readable; dyeing it with the Geo swatch made every portrait the element icon.
        tint(box:GetChild("portrait"), box.name == "hero" and C.buttonPressedText or C.text)
        tint(box:GetChild("border"), selected and C.goldBright or C.line)
        for _, x in ipairs({-1,1}) do for _, y in ipairs({-1,1}) do
            for _, axis in ipairs({'H','V'}) do
                local corner=box:GetChild('target'..axis..x..'_'..y)
                corner:SetVisible(selected == true)
                corner:SetAnchoredPosition(x*portrait/2,y*portrait/2)
            end
        end end
        box:GetChild("name").text = actor.name or "旅行者"
        box:GetChild("name"):SetAnchoredPosition(0,M.geometry(portrait,box.name=='hero').nameY)
        box:GetChild("name"):SetSizeDelta(width, L.nativeText.lineHeight)
    end

    local function healthParts(box, actor, barWidth, barX, y, blocked)
        local bh = L.hpBar.size[2]
        for _, name in ipairs({"hpBorder", "hpTrack", "hpGhost", "hpFill", "hp"}) do
            local part = box:GetChild(name)
            part:SetAnchoredPosition(barX, y)
            local height = name == "hp" and L.nativeText.lineHeight or bh + (name == "hpBorder" and S.border * 2 or 0)
            part:SetSizeDelta(barWidth + (name == "hpBorder" and S.border * 2 or 0), height)
        end
        tint(box:GetChild("hpBorder"), blocked and C.block or C.line)
        tint(box:GetChild("hpFill"), blocked and C.hpShielded or C.hp)
        box:GetChild("hpFill").fillAmount = math.max(0, math.min(1, actor.hp / actor.maxHp))
        box:GetChild("hpGhost").fillAmount = box:GetChild("hpFill").fillAmount
        box:GetChild("hp").text = number(actor.hp) .. "/" .. number(actor.maxHp)
    end

    local function blockParts(box, actor, barWidth, barX, y, blocked, chip)
        for _, name in ipairs({"blockEdge", "blockIcon", "block"}) do
            local part = box:GetChild(name)
            part:SetVisible(blocked)
            local side = name == "blockEdge" and chip + S.border * 2 or chip
            local height = L.blockBadge.size + (name == "blockEdge" and S.border * 2 or 0)
            part:SetSizeDelta(side, name == "block" and L.nativeText.lineHeight or height)
            part:SetAnchoredPosition(barX - barWidth / 2 - L.blockBadge.gap - chip / 2, y)
        end
        tint(box:GetChild("blockEdge"), C.panelSunken)
        tint(box:GetChild("blockIcon"), C.block)
        ink(box:GetChild("block"), C.textOnLight)
        box:GetChild("block").text = number(actor.block)
    end

    local function statusCount(count, entry, x, y, overflow, layout)
        if overflow then
            count:SetAnchoredPosition(x, y)
            count.text = "+" .. (#layout.entries - layout.slots + 1)
            ink(count, C.textDim)
            return x, y
        else
            count:SetAnchoredPosition(x + L.battleUnit.badgeOffset[1], y + L.battleUnit.badgeOffset[2])
            count.text = entry.stack == "none" and "" or entry.amount > 99 and "99+" or number(entry.amount):gsub("^-","−")
            ink(count, C.text)
            return x + L.battleUnit.badgeOffset[1], y + L.battleUnit.badgeOffset[2]
        end
    end

    local function statusPlates(row, i, entry, overflow, x, y, countX, countY)
        local frames = row:GetChild('backplates')
        local edge, body = frames:GetChild('edge' .. i), frames:GetChild('body' .. i)
        local badge = row:GetChild('countBackplates'):GetChild('badge' .. i)
        edge:SetVisible(entry and not overflow or false)
        body:SetVisible(entry and not overflow or false)
        badge:SetVisible(entry and (overflow or entry.stack ~= 'none') or false)
        if not entry then return end
        edge:SetAnchoredPosition(x, y)
        body:SetAnchoredPosition(x, y)
        badge:SetAnchoredPosition(countX, countY)
        tint(edge, statusKind(entry) == 'buff' and C.gold or C.debuff)
    end

    local function statusSlot(row, i, entry, layout)
        local statusImage, count = row:GetChild("icon" .. i), row:GetChild("count" .. i)
        local target = row:GetChild("hit" .. i)
        target:SetVisible(entry and true or false)
        local overflow = entry and i == layout.slots and #layout.entries >= layout.slots
        statusImage:SetVisible(entry and not overflow or false)
        count:SetVisible(entry and true or false)
        if entry then
            local k = i - 1
            local line = math.floor(k / layout.perRow)
            local x = (k % layout.perRow - (math.min(layout.perRow, layout.shown - line * layout.perRow) - 1) / 2) * layout.pitch
            local y = (L.statusIcon.rows - 1) * layout.pitch / 2 - line * layout.pitch
            statusImage:SetAnchoredPosition(x, y)
            target:SetAnchoredPosition(x, y)
            picture(statusImage, Theme.icon.status[entry.icon or entry.id] or Theme.icon.intent[entry.kind] or Theme.icon.intent.unknown)
            tint(statusImage, C.text)
            local countX, countY = statusCount(count, entry, x, y, overflow, layout)
            local digits=math.max(L.statusIcon.size,utf8.len(count.text)*Theme.font.small+S.hairline*2)
            count:SetSizeDelta(digits,L.nativeText.lineHeight)
            row:GetChild("countBackplates"):GetChild("badge"..i):SetSizeDelta(digits,L.statusIcon.size)
            statusPlates(row, i, entry, overflow, x, y, countX, countY)
        else
            statusPlates(row, i)
        end
    end

    local function statuses(box, actor, portrait, width)
        local si, entries, row = L.statusIcon, Combat.statusView(actor), box:GetChild("statusRow")
        local pitch = si.size + si.gap
        local perRow = si.perRow
        local slots = perRow * si.rows
        local layout = {entries = entries, pitch = pitch, perRow = perRow, slots = slots, shown = math.min(#entries, slots)}
        local firstY=M.geometry(portrait,box.name=='hero').firstStatusY
        row:SetAnchoredPosition(0,firstY-(si.rows-1)*pitch/2)
        local lines=math.ceil(layout.shown/perRow)
        local target=row:GetChild("hit")
        target:SetVisible(lines>0)
        target:SetAnchoredPosition(0,(si.rows-lines)*pitch/2)
        target:SetSizeDelta(width,math.max(si.minimumTouch,lines*pitch))
        for i = 1, si.perRow * si.rows do
            statusSlot(row, i, i <= layout.shown and entries[i], layout)
        end
    end

    return function(box, actor, portrait, icon, width, selected, targetWidth)
        portraitParts(box, actor, portrait, icon, width, selected, targetWidth)
        -- Widen the Block chip for native digits rather than shrinking its text.
        local blocked = actor.block > 0
        local chip = math.max(L.blockBadge.size, #number(actor.block) * Theme.font.body + L.blockBadge.padding * 2)
        local geometry=M.geometry(portrait,box.name=='hero')
        local barWidth,barX,y=geometry.healthWidth,0,geometry.healthY
        healthParts(box, actor, barWidth, barX, y, blocked)
        blockParts(box, actor, barWidth, barX, y, blocked, chip)
        statuses(box, actor, portrait, width)
    end
end

return M
