-- Constructor-only enemy ownership. No player, opening AI, deck or relic work.
local Copy=require('abyss_copy').copy
local Actors=require('abyss_actor')
local Effects=require('abyss_effects')
local EnemyAI=require('abyss_enemy_ai')
local Random=require('abyss_sts_random')
local Formation=require('abyss_encounter_formation')
local M={}
local function index(entries)
 local result={};for _,entry in ipairs(entries)do result[entry.id]=entry end;return result
end
local function registerList(catalog,kind,list,label)
 for _,definition in ipairs(list)do
  assert(not catalog[kind][definition.id],'duplicate '..label)
  catalog[kind][definition.id]=Copy(definition)
 end
end
function M.register(catalog)
 require('abyss_act4_enemies').register(catalog)
 require('abyss_act1_bosses').register(catalog,Copy)
 require('abyss_act3_bosses').register(catalog,Copy)
 require('abyss_reptomancer').register(catalog,Copy)
 require('abyss_darklings').register(catalog,Copy)
 for _,entry in ipairs({{require('abyss_act2_enemies'),'Act2'},{require('abyss_act3_enemies'),'Act3'}})do
  registerList(catalog,'enemies',entry[1].enemies,entry[2]..' enemy')
  registerList(catalog,'statuses',entry[1].statuses,entry[2]..' status')
 end
end
local function policy(enemy,kind,detail)
 return enemy.ai and enemy.ai.kind==kind and (detail==nil or enemy.ai.policy==detail)
end
local function splitPolicy(enemy)
 return policy(enemy,'spike_slime_l')or policy(enemy,'acid_slime_l')or policy(enemy,'act1_boss','slime_boss')
end
local function specialMove(enemy,intent)
 local kind,ai=intent.kind,enemy.ai
 local ownerKind=ai and ai.kind
 local supported=kind=='escape'and ownerKind=='looter'
  or kind=='charge'and ownerKind=='charge_then_attack'
  or kind=='split'and splitPolicy(enemy)
 assert(supported and ai[kind..'Intent']==intent.id,kind..' intent requires matching AI')
 assert(type(intent.effects)=='table'and next(intent.effects)==nil,kind..' intent has effects')
end
local function unknownInactive(enemy,intent)
 if policy(enemy,'awakened_one')and intent.id=='rebirth'then return 'Rebirth has effects'end
 if policy(enemy,'act3','exploder')and intent.id=='wait'then return 'Exploder wait has effects'end
 if policy(enemy,'act1_boss')then return 'inactive enemy intent has effects'end
end
local function inactiveMove(enemy,intent)
 if policy(enemy,'darkling')and (intent.id=='regrow'or intent.id=='reincarnate')then return 'Darkling inactive move has effects'end
 if intent.kind=='unknown'then return unknownInactive(enemy,intent)end
 if intent.kind=='sleep'or intent.kind=='stunned'then return 'inactive enemy intent has effects'end
end
local function validateIntent(enemy,intent)
 if require('abyss_act4_enemies').validateIntent(enemy,intent)then return end
 if intent.kind=='charge'or intent.kind=='split'or intent.kind=='escape'then return specialMove(enemy,intent)end
 local inactive=inactiveMove(enemy,intent)
 if inactive then assert(type(intent.effects)=='table'and next(intent.effects)==nil,inactive)
 else assert(Effects.supported(intent.effects),'unsupported enemy intent')end
end
local function sampleHp(state,enemy,explicitHp,hpRandom)
 if not explicitHp and enemy.ai and enemy.ai.preHpRoll then hpRandom(state,enemy.ai.preHpRoll)end
 if explicitHp then enemy.hp=explicitHp
 elseif enemy.hpRange then enemy.hp=enemy.hpRange.min+hpRandom(state,enemy.hpRange.max-enemy.hpRange.min+1)-1
 elseif state.monsterHpRng and not(enemy.ai and enemy.ai.noHpRoll)then hpRandom(state,1)end
end
function M.make(state,id,serial,explicitHp,hpRandom)
 local enemy=Copy(assert(state.catalog.enemies[id],'unknown enemy: '..tostring(id)))
 if policy(enemy,'act3','transient')then require('abyss_act3_enemies').bindSharedStatuses(state.catalog.statuses,Copy)end
 sampleHp(state,enemy,explicitHp,hpRandom)
 EnemyAI.prepare(state,enemy,hpRandom)
 for _,intent in ipairs(enemy.intents)do validateIntent(enemy,intent)end
 enemy.definitionId,enemy.id,enemy.maxHp=id,id..'_'..serial,enemy.hp
 enemy.block,enemy.statuses,enemy.intentIndex=0,{},1
 Actors.bindStatuses(enemy,state.catalog.statuses)
 return enemy
end
local function sourceSpec(options)
 if options.sourceEncounter~=nil then
  assert(Formation.supports(options.sourceEncounter),'unknown source formation')
  assert(options.enemies==nil,'source formation cannot mix with explicit enemies')
  assert(type(options.encounterBoundary)=='table','source formation needs explicit boundaries')
 end
end
function M.group(state,options,construct)
 sourceSpec(options)
 if options.sourceEncounter~=nil then
  local callbacks,constructors=options.encounterBoundary,0
  state.enemies=Formation.assemble(options.sourceEncounter,{
   misc=callbacks.misc,visualFloat=callbacks.visualFloat,construct=function(id,x,y)
    constructors=constructors+1
    local actor=construct(state,id,constructors);actor.sourcePosition={x=x,y=y};return actor
   end})
  state.sourceEncounter=options.sourceEncounter
  for i,enemy in ipairs(state.enemies)do enemy.id=enemy.definitionId..'_'..i end
  state.nextEnemyId=#state.enemies+1
 else
  local ids=options.enemies or {'cultist'};assert(#ids>0,'empty encounter')
  for i,id in ipairs(ids)do state.enemies[#state.enemies+1]=construct(state,id,i);state.nextEnemyId=i+1 end
 end
end
local function constructorCatalog(data)
 local prepared,catalog=require('abyss_combat_catalog').prepare(data)
 catalog.enemies=require('abyss_combat_catalog').enemies(prepared)
 catalog.potions=index(Copy(prepared.potions and prepared.potions.potions or {}))
 M.register(catalog);return catalog
end
local function keys(catalog)
 local result={}
 for _,kind in ipairs({'cards','enemies','statuses'})do
  result[kind]={};for id in pairs(catalog[kind])do result[kind][id]=true end
 end
 return result
end
local function additions(catalog,before)
 local result={}
 for kind,ids in pairs(before)do
  result[kind]={};for id,definition in pairs(catalog[kind])do if not ids[id]then result[kind][id]=Copy(definition)end end
 end
 return result
end
function M.prepare(data,options,construct)
 assert(type(options)=='table'and type(options.roomSeed)=='string','preparation needs raw room seed')
 assert(options.preparedEncounter==nil,'cannot prepare an already prepared encounter')
 assert(options.sourceEncounter~=nil or options.enemies~=nil,'preparation needs explicit encounter identity')
 sourceSpec(options)
 local streams=assert(options.roomStreams,'preparation needs source room streams')
 local state={catalog=constructorCatalog(data),monsterHpRng=Random.cloneState(streams.monsterHpRng),
  enemies={},nextEnemyId=1,roomSeed=options.roomSeed}
 local before=keys(state.catalog)
 M.group(state,options,construct)
 local ids={};for _,actor in ipairs(state.enemies)do ids[#ids+1]=actor.definitionId end
 return {version=1,roomSeed=options.roomSeed,sourceEncounter=options.sourceEncounter,enemyIds=Copy(options.enemies),
  actorIds=ids,actors=state.enemies,monsterHpRng=Random.snapshot(state.monsterHpRng),catalogAdditions=additions(state.catalog,before)}
end
local function validatePrepared(prepared,options)
 assert(type(prepared)=='table'and prepared.version==1,'invalid prepared encounter')
 assert(prepared.roomSeed==options.roomSeed,'prepared encounter room seed mismatch')
 assert(options.enemies==nil and options.sourceEncounter==nil,'prepared encounter cannot mix with enemies or source formation')
 if prepared.sourceEncounter~=nil then
  assert(Formation.supports(prepared.sourceEncounter),'prepared encounter source missing')
  assert(prepared.enemyIds==nil,'prepared formation cannot mix with explicit enemies')
 else
  assert(type(prepared.enemyIds)=='table','prepared explicit enemy identities missing')
 end
 assert(type(prepared.actors)=='table'and #prepared.actors>0,'empty prepared encounter')
 assert(type(prepared.actorIds)=='table'and #prepared.actorIds==#prepared.actors,'prepared actor identities missing')
end
local function adoptAdditions(catalog,preparedAdditions)
 for _,kind in ipairs({'cards','enemies','statuses'})do
  for id,definition in pairs(preparedAdditions[kind]or {})do
   assert(not catalog[kind][id],'prepared constructor definition conflicts with current catalog')
   catalog[kind][id]=Copy(definition)
  end
 end
end
local function validateActor(state,actor,actorIndex,prepared)
 assert(state.catalog.enemies[actor.definitionId],'prepared enemy definition missing')
 assert(actor.definitionId==prepared.actorIds[actorIndex],'prepared actor identity mismatch')
 assert(actor.id==actor.definitionId..'_'..actorIndex and actor.hp==actor.maxHp and actor.hp>0,'invalid prepared enemy identity or HP')
 assert(actor.block==0 and actor.intentIndex==1 and type(actor.statuses)=='table'and next(actor.statuses)==nil,'prepared actor already initialized')
 if prepared.enemyIds then assert(actor.definitionId==prepared.enemyIds[actorIndex],'prepared actor source mismatch')end
 Actors.bindStatuses(actor,state.catalog.statuses)
end
function M.adopt(state,options)
 local prepared=options.preparedEncounter;validatePrepared(prepared,options)
 assert(state.roomSeed==prepared.roomSeed,'prepared encounter requires source room streams')
 adoptAdditions(state.catalog,assert(prepared.catalogAdditions,'prepared constructor definitions missing'))
 state.monsterHpRng=Random.restore(prepared.monsterHpRng)
 state.enemies=Copy(prepared.actors)
 for i,actor in ipairs(state.enemies)do validateActor(state,actor,i,prepared)end
 state.sourceEncounter=prepared.sourceEncounter;state.nextEnemyId=#state.enemies+1
end
return M

-- Native focus/event adapter. Card-row wrapping follows STS1 CardRewardScreen's
-- updateControllerInput; engine calls use the official Miliastra Lua API.
local M = {}
local function visible(control)
    while control do
        if control.alive == false or control.visible == false or control.activeInHierarchy == false then return false end
        control = control.parent
    end
    return true
end
function M.new(api,root)
    if not api or not api.events or not api.getFocus or not api.setFocus then return nil end
    local manager = {api=api,records={},byControl={},memory={}}
    local function clear(control)
        control.canControllerFocus=false
        if control.GetChildren then for _,child in ipairs(control:GetChildren())do clear(child)end end
    end
    if root then clear(root) end
    function manager:eligible(record)
        local scope=type(record.scope)=='function' and record.scope() or record.scope
        return not not (not self.disabled and scope==self.scope
            and visible(record.control) and record.control.raycastTarget~=false
            and (not record.enabled or record.enabled()))
    end
    function manager:focus(control)
        local record=self.byControl[control]
        if record and self:eligible(record) and self.api.isController() then
            self.api.setFocus(control);self.memory[self.scope]=control;return true
        end
        return false
    end
    function manager:sync(scope,cancel)
        local changed=self.scope~=scope
        if changed then
            local previous=self.api.getFocus()
            if previous and self.byControl[previous] then self.memory[self.scope or '']=previous end
            self.scope=scope
        end
        self.cancel=cancel
        local first,groups=nil,{}
        for _,record in ipairs(self.records) do
            local ok=self:eligible(record)
            if record.control.alive~=false and record.control.canControllerFocus~=ok then record.control.canControllerFocus=ok end
            if ok then
                if not first or record.order<first.order then first=record end
                if record.group then
                    local group=groups[record.group] or {};groups[record.group]=group;group[#group+1]=record
                end
            end
        end
        for _,group in pairs(groups) do
            table.sort(group,function(a,b)return a.order<b.order end)
            for i,record in ipairs(group) do
                for _,direction in ipairs({'Left','Right'}) do
                    local target=group[(i-1+(direction=='Left' and -1 or 1))%#group+1].control
                    record.links=record.links or {}
                    if record.links[direction]~=target then
                        record.control:SetControllerNavigation(self.api.directions[direction],self.api.modes.Specified,target)
                        record.links[direction]=target
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local current=self.api.getFocus()
        local record=current and self.byControl[current]
        local using=self.api.isController()
        if not using then return end
        if changed or not record or not self:eligible(record) then
            local saved=self.memory[self.scope]
            if not (saved and self:focus(saved)) and first then self.api.setFocus(first.control) end
        end
    end
    function manager:tick()self.consumed=false end
    function manager:disable()
        self.disabled=true
        for _,record in ipairs(self.records)do if record.control.alive~=false then record.control.canControllerFocus=false end end
    end
    function manager:activate(control,fn)
        local record=self.byControl[control]
        if self.disabled or self.consumed or not self.api.isController()
            or self.api.getFocus()~=control or not self:eligible(record) then return false end
        self.consumed=true
        if self.beforeAction then self.beforeAction()end
        local result,reason=fn()
        if self.onChange then self.onChange() end
        return result,reason
    end
    return manager
end
function M.pointerBlocked(manager)
    return manager and manager.consumed and manager.api.isController() or false
end
function M.isController(manager)return manager and manager.api.isController() or false end
function M.bind(manager,control,scope,action,enabled,order,group,onFocus)
    if not manager then return action end
    assert(not manager.byControl[control],'duplicate controller binding')
    local record={control=control,scope=scope,enabled=enabled,order=order or 100,group=group}
    manager.byControl[control]=record;manager.records[#manager.records+1]=record
    control.canControllerFocus=false
    control:AddNavigationEventListener(manager.api.events.Confirm,function()return manager:activate(control,action)end)
    control:AddNavigationEventListener(manager.api.events.Cancel,function()
        return manager:activate(control,function()if manager.cancel then return manager.cancel()end return false end)
    end)
    if onFocus and manager.api.events.Focus then
        control:AddNavigationEventListener(manager.api.events.Focus,function()
            if manager:eligible(record)then return onFocus()end
        end)
    end
    return action
end
return M

function M.withCards(data)

function M.initHistory(state)

 state.orbChannelCounts={lightning=0,frost=0,dark=0,plasma=0}
end
function M.channelCount(state,kind)
 assert(kinds[kind],'unknown channel history kind')
 return integer(state.orbChannelCounts and state.orbChannelCounts[kind] or 0)
end
function M.onChannel(state,kind)
 assert(kinds[kind] and state.orbChannelCounts,'channel history not initialized')
 state.orbChannelCounts[kind]=add(M.channelCount(state,kind),1)
end
local function active(a)return Actors.isActive(a) and not a.halfDead and not a.isDying and not a.isEscaping end
local function targets(state)
 local out={};for _,a in ipairs(state.enemies)do if active(a)then out[#out+1]=a end end;return out
end
function M.adaptDefinition(state,instance,definition)
 local id=instance.cardId
 if id~='claw' and id~='stack' and id~='steam_barrier' and id~='blizzard' and id~='thunder_strike' then return definition end
 local out=copy(definition)
 if id=='claw' then out.effects[1].value=add(out.effects[1].value,integer(instance.engineClawBonus or 0))
 elseif id=='stack' then out.effects[1]=e('block',add(#state.discard,out.effects[1].value))
 elseif id=='steam_barrier' then out.effects[1].value=out.effects[1].value-integer(instance.engineBlockLoss or 0)
 elseif id=='blizzard' then out.effects[1].value=integer(M.channelCount(state,'frost')*1.0*out.effects[1].perOrb)
 elseif id=='thunder_strike' then out.effects[1].count=M.channelCount(state,'lightning') end

end
function M.prepareEffect(state,effect,target,_context)
 local out=copy(effect)
 if effect.op=='autoShields' then
  out.enabled=state.player.block==0;out.value=integer(Actors.blockAmount(state,state.player,effect.value));out.fixed=true
 elseif effect.op=='stackBlock' then
  out=e('block',integer(Actors.blockAmount(state,state.player,add(#state.discard,effect.value))),{fixed=true})
 elseif effect.op=='blizzardDamage' then
  out.value=integer(M.channelCount(state,'frost')*1.0*integer(effect.perOrb));out.normalAmounts={}

 elseif effect.op=='sunderDamage' then
  assert(target,'Sunder target missing');out.normalAmount=integer(Actors.attackAmount(state,state.player,target,effect.value))
 elseif effect.op=='chillOrbs' then out.count=integer(#targets(state)*1.0*integer(effect.value))
 elseif effect.op=='chaosOrbs' then
  assert(effect.value==1 or effect.value==2,'invalid Chaos count')
  local rng=Random.cloneState(assert(state.cardRandomRng,'Chaos requires cardRandomRng'));out.orbs={}
  local order={'dark','frost','lightning','plasma'}
  for i=1,effect.value do out.orbs[i]=order[Random.randomInt(rng,3)+1]end
  return out,rng
 elseif effect.op=='thunderStrike' then out.count=M.channelCount(state,'lightning')
 end
 return out
end
local function instanceByUid(state,uid)
 local found=state.cardInUse and state.cardInUse.uid==uid and state.cardInUse or nil
 for _,pile in ipairs({state.hand,state.draw,state.discard,state.exhaust})do
  for _,c in ipairs(pile)do if c.uid==uid then assert(not found,'duplicate battle instance');found=c end end
 end
 return assert(found,'missing engine battle instance')
end
local function nextRound(op,value,remaining,extra)
 local x=extra or {};x.remaining=remaining;return e(op,value,x)

  for _,a in ipairs(state.enemies)do if a.id==effect.targetId and (a.hp<=0 or a.isDying)then p.bottom[1]=e('energy',3)end end

  local x=context.energyOnUse;if x==nil or x==-1 then x=state.energy end;integer(x)

function M.applyLockOn(state,target,amount)

  local value=target.statuses.lock_on

   integer(value);target.statuses.lock_on=value>1 and value-1 or nil

-- Java float multiplication in AbstractOrb.applyLockOn, including int saturation.
function M.orbDamage(target,amount)

end

-- EventRoom owns its constructor and fixed rewards independently of map queues.
local C=require('abyss_combat')
local R=require('abyss_sts_random')
local Gold=require('abyss_gold_rewards')
local Potion=require('abyss_potion_rewards')
local Cards=require('abyss_card_pool')
local Hooks=require('abyss_relic_hooks')
local M={}
local bosses={['The Guardian']=true,Hexaghost=true,['Slime Boss']=true}
local function encounter(source)
 if source=='The Mushroom Lair'then
  return {id='event_mushrooms',tier='normal',source=source,sourceEncounter=source}
 end
 if source=='2 Orb Walkers'then
  return {id='event_orb_walkers',tier='normal',source=source,sourceEncounter=source}
 end
 if not bosses[source]then return nil end
 local result=require('abyss_act1_bosses').resolve(source,'boss')
 result.tier='normal' -- This is an EventRoom, including when the actors are Bosses.
 return result
end
local function roomOptions(room,definition)
 local options={roomSeed=room.seed,roomStreams=room,enemies=definition.enemies,sourceEncounter=definition.sourceEncounter}
 if definition.sourceEncounter then
  options.encounterBoundary={misc={boolean=function()return R.randomBoolean(room.miscRng)end,
   integer=function(lo,hi)return R.randomIntBetween(room.miscRng,lo,hi)end},
   visualFloat=function(lo,hi)return R.randomFloatBetween(room.visualRng,lo,hi)end}
 end
 return options
end
function M.prepare(run,source,floor,roomStreams,misc)
 if type(floor)~='number'or floor%1~=0 then return nil,'event_constructor_unavailable'end
 local act=run.act or 1
 local allowed=source=='The Mushroom Lair'and act==1 and floor>=7 and floor<=14
  or source~='The Mushroom Lair'and act==3 and floor>=35 and floor<=49
 if run.campaign~=true or not allowed then
  return nil,'event_constructor_unavailable'
 end
 local definition=encounter(source);if not definition then return nil,'event_encounter_unavailable'end
 local room=roomStreams(run,floor);room.miscRng=R.cloneState(misc or run.miscRng)
 local prepared=C.prepareEncounter(run.data,roomOptions(room,definition))
 return {version=1,source=source,floor=floor,runSeed=run.runSeed,roomSeed=room.seed,prepared=prepared}
end
local function validRequest(flow,request)
 if type(request)~='table'or getmetatable(request)~=nil or request.roomClass~='event'then return false end
 if type(request.gold)~='number'or request.gold%1~=0 then return false end
 if flow.event.id=='mushrooms'then
  return request.sourceEncounter=='The Mushroom Lair'and request.gold>=20 and request.gold<=30
   and(request.fixedRelicId=='odd_mushroom'or request.fixedRelicId=='circlet')and request.relicTier==nil
 end
 if request.relicTier~='rare'or request.fixedRelicId~=nil then return false end
 if flow.event.id=='mysterious_sphere'then
  return request.sourceEncounter=='2 Orb Walkers'and request.gold>=45 and request.gold<=55
 end
 return flow.event.id=='mind_bloom'and bosses[request.sourceEncounter]==true and request.gold==50
end
local function preparedFor(run,flow,request,roomStreams)
 local prepared=flow.event.preparedCombat
 if not prepared and(flow.event.id=='mysterious_sphere'or flow.event.id=='mushrooms')then return nil,'event_constructor_missing'end
 if not prepared then prepared=M.prepare(run,request.sourceEncounter,run.floor,roomStreams)end
 if type(prepared)~='table'or prepared.version~=1 or prepared.source~=request.sourceEncounter
  or prepared.floor~=run.floor or prepared.runSeed~=run.runSeed
  or prepared.roomSeed~=roomStreams(run,run.floor).seed then return nil,'event_constructor_mismatch'end
 return prepared
end
function M.start(run,flow,api,startEncounter)
 if run.phase~='node'or type(flow)~='table'or flow~=run.nodeFlow or flow.type~='event'or flow.complete then return false,'event_combat_unavailable'end
 local request=flow.event and flow.event.combatRequest
 if not validRequest(flow,request)then return false,'invalid_event_combat_request'end
 if flow.event.id=='mushrooms'and(run.act~=1 or run.floor<7 or run.floor>14)then return false,'event_combat_unavailable'end
 local prepared,why=preparedFor(run,flow,request,api.roomStreams);if not prepared then return false,why end
 -- Source creates actors, then GOLD, then a fixed SPECIAL or drawn RARE.
 local gold=Gold.offerAmount(request.gold,run)
 local offer,pool
 if flow.event.id=='mushrooms'then
  local expected=Hooks.owns(run,'odd_mushroom')and'circlet'or'odd_mushroom'
  if request.fixedRelicId~=expected then return false,'event_reward_mismatch'end
  for _,def in ipairs(run.data.relics.relics)do
   if def.id==expected and def.rarity=='special'then offer={id=def.id,sourceId=def.sourceId,tier='special'}end
  end
  if not offer then return false,'event_relic_unavailable'end
  pool=run.relicPool -- Fixed SPECIAL never consumes a source rarity/queue draw.
 else offer,pool=api.prepareRelic(run,{tier='rare',room='event',screenless=flow.event.id=='mysterious_sphere'})end
 if not offer then return false,pool end
 local room=api.roomStreams(run,run.floor)
 room.miscRng=R.cloneState(run.miscRng)
 room.monsterHpRng=R.restore(prepared.prepared.monsterHpRng)
 room.preparedEncounter=prepared.prepared
 run.phase,run.relicPool='map',pool
 local called,ok,reason=pcall(startEncounter,run,encounter(request.sourceEncounter),room)
 if not called or not ok then return false,called and reason or 'event_combat_unavailable'end
 run.eventCombat={eventId=flow.event.id,source=request.sourceEncounter,encounterId=run.encounterId,
  floor=run.floor,runSeed=run.runSeed,combatGeneration=run.combatGeneration,
  gold=gold,relics={{id=offer.id,sourceId=offer.sourceId,rarity=offer.tier,
   requestedId=offer.requestedId,requestedTier=offer.tier,trace=offer.trace,claimed=false}}}
 flow.event.preparedCombat=prepared
 flow.eventCombat,flow.encounterId,flow.encounterSource=true,run.encounterId,request.sourceEncounter
 return true,'combat'
end
local function ownerMatches(run)
 local context,flow,battle=run.eventCombat,run.nodeFlow,run.combat
 if type(context)~='table'or not flow or flow.type~='event'or not flow.eventCombat or not flow.event
  or flow.event.id~=context.eventId or context.encounterId~=run.encounterId or flow.encounterId~=run.encounterId
  or context.runSeed~=run.runSeed or context.floor~=run.floor
  or context.combatGeneration~=run.combatGeneration or battle.combatGeneration~=run.combatGeneration then
  return false
 end
 return true
end
function M.finish(run)
 if not ownerMatches(run)then return nil,'event_combat_owner_mismatch'end
 local context=run.eventCombat
 -- Preserve pre-created GOLD/RARE, then source EventRoom potion and card order.
 local potion,potionRng,modifier=Potion.prepare(run,2,{allEscaped=false})
 Potion.commit(run,potionRng,modifier)
 local choices,cardRng,offset,upgrades=Cards.prepareRewards(run)
 run.cardRng,run.cardRarityOffset=cardRng,offset
 local rewards={gold=context.gold,goldClaimed=context.gold==0,relics=C.copy(context.relics),
  cards=choices,cardUpgrades=upgrades,potion=potion,cardResolved=false,manualContinue=true}
 Hooks.previewCardReward(run,rewards,true)
 return rewards
end
function M.escape(run)
 if not ownerMatches(run)then return false,'event_combat_owner_mismatch'end
 -- A smoke screen discards all offers. EventRoom still attempts a potion,
 -- without a card reward or an all-monsters-escaped zero-chance override.
 local _,potionRng,modifier=Potion.prepare(run,2,{allEscaped=false})
 Potion.commit(run,potionRng,modifier)
 run.eventCombat=nil
 return true
end
return M

-- Detached, bounded-size presentation frames. No callbacks, RNG or rule writes.
local M = {}
local function originalView(value)
    if type(value)~='table'then return value end
    local result={}
    for k,v in pairs(value)do if k~='commands' and k~='enemyAction'then result[k]=originalView(v)end end
    return result
end
local function actor(a)
    local result = {}
    for k, v in pairs(a) do result[k] = v end
    result.statuses = {}
    for k, v in pairs(a.statuses) do result.statuses[k] = v end
    if a.originalV4 then result.originalV4=originalView(a.originalV4)end
    if a.v4Bloom then result.v4Bloom=originalView(a.v4Bloom)end
    if a.v4Directive then result.v4Directive=originalView(a.v4Directive)end
    return result
end
function M.frame(state)
    local result = { player = actor(state.player), enemies = {}, phase = state.phase,
        turn = state.turn, energy = state.energy }
    if state.spirePair then result.spirePair={facingLeft=state.spirePair.facingLeft}end
    if state.discardedThisTurn~=nil then result.discardedThisTurn=state.discardedThisTurn end
    for i, a in ipairs(state.enemies) do result.enemies[i] = actor(a) end
    for _, name in ipairs({"hand", "draw", "discard", "exhaust"}) do
        result[name] = {}
        for i, card in ipairs(state[name]) do
            local entry = {}
            for k, v in pairs(card) do entry[k] = v end
            result[name][i] = entry
        end
    end
    if state.originalV4 then result.originalV4=originalView(state.originalV4);result.player.originalV4=result.originalV4 end
    if state.orbs then
        local o=state.orbs
        result.orbs={slots=o.slots,focus=o.focus,balls={}}
        for i,ball in ipairs(o.balls) do
            local entry={};for k,v in pairs(ball) do entry[k]=v end
            result.orbs.balls[i]=entry
        end
    end
    return result
end
function M.emit(state, kind, detail)
    local entry = { kind = kind, detail = detail, frame = M.frame(state) }
    state.events[#state.events + 1] = entry
    return entry
end
return M

-- Presentation only. Core commands have already committed before this runs.
-- Reuses native controls and OnUpdate; no coroutine, timers, assets or Tween callbacks.
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local EnemyView=require('abyss_battle_enemy_view')
local UnitView=require('abyss_battle_unit_view')
local Actors=require('abyss_actor')
local ActorMotion=require('abyss_actor_motion')
local SkillFeedback=require('abyss_skill_feedback')
local ActorPainter=require("abyss_feedback_actor_painter")
local MonsterArt=require('abyss_monster_art')
local CardFlow=require('abyss_card_flow')
local M = {}
local T, C, L, S = Theme.motion, Theme.color, Theme.layout, Theme.space
local ROW = (L.enemyRow.xFrom + L.enemyRow.xTo) / 2
-- Curve shapes, not tunables: pop overshoot, gentle swell and peak portrait flash strength.
local OVERSHOOT, SWELL = 1 / 3, 1 / 6
-- Fixed action waits from DamageAction / DamageAllEnemiesAction at sts@319009d5.
-- Theme hit-stop belongs to the independent VFX clock, never the action gate.
local DAMAGE_DURATION, AREA_DURATION, POST_ATTACK_WAIT = 0.1, 0.25, 0.1
local skipDamageWait = {brilliance = true, flechettes = true, barrage = true}
local function n(value) return string.format("%.0f", value or 0) end
local function clamp(x) return x < 0 and 0 or x > 1 and 1 or x end
local function easeOut(x) x = clamp(x) return 1 - (1 - x) * (1 - x) end
local function easeIn(x) x = clamp(x) return x * x end
local function hurts(kind) return kind == "damage" or kind == "hp_loss" or kind == "status_damage" end
local banners = {enemy_turn = true, player_turn = true, victory = true, defeat = true}
local timedLossNames = {lose_strength="回合末失去力量", lose_dexterity="回合末失去敏捷"}
local function skillContext(entry,catalog)
    local d=type(entry.detail)=='table' and entry.detail or {}
    if entry.kind=='play' then return {effects=catalog.cards[d.cardId].effects} end
    for _,unit in ipairs(entry.frame and entry.frame.enemies or {})do
        if unit.id==d.enemy then
            for _,intent in ipairs(unit.intents or {})do
                if intent.id==d.id then return {enemyId=unit.definitionId,intentId=d.id,intentKind=intent.kind,effects=intent.effects} end
            end
        end
    end
    return {}
end

-- Shape of each hit, read from the committed card/intent and the actual event amounts only.
-- form: single | multi | area | dot | self; weight: light | normal | heavy.
local function classify(queue, catalog)
    local styles, context = {}, nil
    for i, entry in ipairs(queue) do
        local d = type(entry.detail) == "table" and entry.detail or {}
        if entry.kind == "play" or entry.kind == "intent" or banners[entry.kind] or entry.kind == "potion" then
            local area = false
            if entry.kind == "play" then
                for _, effect in ipairs(catalog.cards[d.cardId].effects) do area = area or effect.op == "damageAll" end
            end
            context = {kind = entry.kind, area = area, cardId = d.cardId, hits = {}}
            local skill=skillContext(entry,catalog)
            context.family=SkillFeedback.resolve(entry.kind,d,skill)
            styles[i] = {context = context}
        else
            local style = {context = context}
            styles[i] = style
            if entry.kind == "damage" and context then
                style.target = d.target
                context.hits[#context.hits + 1] = style
            end
            if entry.kind == "status_damage" then style.form = "dot"
            elseif entry.kind == "hp_loss" then style.form = "self" end
            local total = (d.amount or 0) + (d.blocked or 0)
            style.weight = total >= T.heavyHitDamage and "heavy" or "normal"
            local victim = entry.frame and d.target
            if victim then
                for _, a in ipairs(entry.frame.enemies) do
                    if a.id == victim and a.hp <= 0 then style.lethal = true end
                end
                if victim == "player" and entry.frame.player.hp <= 0 then style.lethal = true end
            end
            if entry.kind == "damage" and (d.amount or 0) > 0 then
                style.stop = (style.weight == "heavy" or style.lethal) and T.hitStopHeavy or T.hitStop
            end
        end
    end
    for _, style in ipairs(styles) do
        local groupContext = style.context
        if groupContext and not groupContext.classified then
            groupContext.classified = true
            local rounds, round, targets = {}, {}, {}
            for _, hit in ipairs(groupContext.hits) do
                -- Repeated damageAll actions (Whirlwind) have one action wait
                -- and one contact cue per pass, not one for the entire card.
                if groupContext.area and targets[hit.target] then
                    rounds[#rounds + 1], round, targets = round, {}, {}
                end
                round[#round + 1], targets[hit.target] = hit, true
            end
            rounds[#rounds + 1] = round
            for _, group in ipairs(rounds) do for k, hit in ipairs(group) do
                hit.form = groupContext.area and "area" or #group > 1 and "multi" or "single"
                hit.hit, hit.hits = k, #group
            end
            end
        end
    end
    for i,entry in ipairs(queue)do
        local d=type(entry.detail)=='table' and entry.detail or {}
        local style=styles[i]
        local status=catalog.statuses[d.status]
        style.family=SkillFeedback.resolve(entry.kind,d,{family=style.context and style.context.family,
            weight=style.weight,statusKind=status and status.kind})
    end
    return styles
end

local function duration(entry, style, fastMode)
    local kind = entry.kind
    if kind == "action_wait" then
        return fastMode and math.min(entry.detail.seconds, 0.1) or entry.detail.seconds
    end
    if kind == "play" then return T.base end
    if kind == "player_death" then return T.playerDeath end
    if banners[kind] then return T.banner end
    if kind == "intent" then return T.enemyActionGap end
    if kind == "enemy_escape" then return T.enemyEscape end
    if kind == "gold_stolen" then return T.base end
    if kind == "death" then return entry.detail.chained and 0 or T.slow end
    -- Area hits land on consecutive rendered frames: one shockwave rippling across the row.
    if kind == "damage" and style.form == "area" and style.hit < style.hits then return 0 end
    if kind == "damage" then
        local context = style.context or {}
        local base = style.form == "area" and context.cardId ~= "whirlwind" and AREA_DURATION or DAMAGE_DURATION
        local skip = fastMode or skipDamageWait[context.cardId] and style.form ~= "area"
        return base + (not skip and POST_ATTACK_WAIT or 0)
    end
    if hurts(kind) or kind == "block" or kind == "status" or kind == "heal" then return T.base end
    return 0
end

function M.new(stage, platform, present, complete)
    local self = { busy = false, fastMode = false, effects = {}, deaths = {}, dying = {}, poses = {}, escaping = {}, slotOwners = {} }
    local overlay = stage:GetChild("feedback")
    function self.bindIdle(_owner,battle)

            or battle and self.battle and self.battle~=battle

        self.idleBattle = battle
        if battle and not self.busy then self.shadow = battle end
    end
    self.cardFlow=CardFlow.new(stage,platform)
    local function colour(c, alpha) return platform.color(c.r, c.g, c.b, math.floor((c.a or 255) * (alpha or 1))) end
    local function tint(box, c, alpha) box.imageColor = colour(c, alpha) end
    local function actor(id)
        if id == "player" then
            local lift=UnitView.noticeLift(self.shadow.player,L.player.portrait,L.player.position[2],true)
            return self.shadow.player,stage:GetChild("hero"),L.player.position[1],L.player.position[2]+lift
        end
        local rows=self.busy and self.enemyRows or EnemyView.slots(self.shadow)
        for slot,entry in ipairs(rows)do if entry.id==id then
            local x,_,_,_,y=EnemyView.position(#rows,slot,entry.actor)
            return entry.actor,stage:GetChild('enemy'..slot),x,y
        end end
        for _,a in ipairs(self.shadow.enemies)do if a.id==id then return a end end
    end
    local painter = {state=self, actor=actor, platform=platform}
    local function banner(text, danger)
        local label = overlay:GetChild("banner")
        self.bannerInk = danger and C.danger or C.goldBright
        label.text, label.fontColor = text, colour(self.bannerInk)
        label:SetVisible(true) overlay:GetChild("bannerPlate"):SetVisible(true)
    end
    -- Steps keep the sweep and a landing card; reset and finish clear everything.
    local function hideOverlay(landing, all)
        if self.cast then overlay:GetChild('sweep'):SetVisible(false) end
        self.cast=nil
        if not landing then self.dissolve = nil end
        if all then self.sweep = nil end
        local names = {"banner", "bannerPlate"}
        if not landing then names[#names + 1] = "playedCard" end
        if all then names[#names + 1] = "sweep" names[#names + 1] = "deathShade" end
        for _, name in ipairs(names) do pcall(function() overlay:GetChild(name):SetVisible(false) end) end
    end
    local function sound(cue)
        -- IDs come from the platform catalogue. Candidate audibility still needs real playtest.
        if platform.sound then
            local ok, reason = pcall(platform.sound, cue)
            if not ok then print("ABYSS_AUDIO unavailable " .. cue .. " " .. tostring(reason)) end
        end
    end
    local function resetUnit(name)
        local box = stage:GetChild(name)
        MonsterArt.clearBox(box)
        for _, part in ipairs({"impact", "shield", "floating"}) do pcall(function() box:GetChild(part):SetVisible(false) end) end
        for _, part in ipairs({"portrait", "impact", "shield", "blockEdge", "blockIcon", "block"}) do
            pcall(function() local c = box:GetChild(part) c:SetLocalScale(1, 1, 1) if not part:find("^block") then c:SetAnchoredPosition(0, 0) end end)
        end
        tint(box:GetChild("portrait"), name == "hero" and C.geo or C.text)
        if name == "hero" and platform.portraits then platform.portraits:battlePose(0,0,1,1) end
    end
    function self.bindEnemySlot(slot,id)
        if self.slotOwners[slot]~=id then resetUnit('enemy'..slot) self.slotOwners[slot]=id end
    end
    function self.reset(_owner,retainHistory)
        -- Hiding/rewards retire visuals, but terminal death evidence still belongs
        -- to this battle. Cancellation and the next battle clear that history.
        local history=retainHistory and self.deaths or {}
        self.battle = retainHistory and (self.battle or self.idleBattle) or nil
        self.idleBattle, self.idleClock, self.shadow = nil, 0, nil
        self.cardFlow:reset()
        stage:SetAnchoredPosition(0, 0)
        self.stageShake = 0
        hideOverlay(false, true)
        for _, name in ipairs({"banner", "bannerPlate"}) do
            pcall(function() local part = overlay:GetChild(name) part:SetAnchoredPosition(0, S.xxl) part:SetLocalScale(1, 1, 1) end)
        end
        for _, name in ipairs({"hero", "enemy1", "enemy2", "enemy3", "enemy4", "enemy5"}) do
            resetUnit(name)
        end
        self.slotOwners={}
        self.effects, self.deaths, self.dying, self.poses, self.sweep, self.escaping = {}, history, {}, {}, nil, {}
    end
    local function finish(failure)
        local wasBusy = self.busy
        if not failure and self.battle and self.shadow then
            local ok,reason=pcall(function()
                self.cardFlow:sync(self.shadow,self.battle,nil,true)
                self.cardFlow:update(0,self.battle.catalog,self.presentation,self.fastMode)
            end)
            if not ok then failure=reason end
        end
        self.busy, self.queue, self.current = false, nil, nil
        -- Cleanup errors are isolated so input always releases, even if an effect control failed.
        if failure then pcall(self.reset, self) end
        hideOverlay(false, true)
        if failure then print("ABYSS_FEEDBACK recovered " .. tostring(failure)) end
        if wasBusy then complete(failure) end
    end
    function self.cancel()
        if self.busy then finish("cancelled") else self:reset() end
    end
    -- Attacker body language: pull back, strike, recover. Enemies face the traveler (−x).
    local function strike(id, stop)
        local reach = id == "player" and S.l or -S.l
        self.poses[id] = {age = 0, keys = {{0, reach, 1}, {stop, reach, 1}, {stop + T.slow, 0, 1}}}
    end
    local function cardShape(definition)
        local targetsEnemy, area, attack = false, false, false
        for _, effect in ipairs(definition.effects) do
            targetsEnemy = targetsEnemy or effect.op == "damage" or effect.op == "damageEqualToBlock" or effect.op == "applyStatus"
            area = area or effect.op == "damageAll" or effect.op == "applyStatusAll"
            attack = attack or effect.op == "damage" or effect.op == "damageEqualToBlock" or effect.op == "damageAll"
        end
        return targetsEnemy,area,attack
    end
    local function cardFlight(d,targetsEnemy,area)
        local target = (targetsEnemy or area) and self.shadow.enemies[d.target or 1]
        local _, _, x, y = actor(target and target.id or "player")
        if area then x = ROW end
        self.flight = { x = self.origin and self.origin[1] or 0, y = self.origin and self.origin[2] or L.hand.y, tx = x, ty = y }
    end
    local function contactSound(d,style)
        -- One cue per contact; an area ripple shares the first target's cue.
        if style.form ~= "area" or style.hit == 1 then
            if (d.amount or 0) > 0 then
                sound(d.target == "player" and "hurt" or style.weight == "heavy" and "hit_heavy" or "hit")
            elseif (d.blocked or 0) > 0 then sound("block_hit") end
        end
    end
    local function statusDamageLabel(d,text,ink)
        if d.status then
            local status = self.shadow.catalog.statuses[d.status]
            text = (status and status.name or d.status)
                .. ((d.blocked or 0) > 0 and " 格挡 " .. n(d.blocked) or "")
                .. ((d.amount or 0) > 0 and " −" .. n(d.amount) or "")
            ink = (d.blocked or 0) > 0 and C.block or C.debuff
        end
        return text,ink
    end
    local function damageLabel(d)
        local text,ink
        text, ink = n(d.amount), C.danger
        if (d.blocked or 0) > 0 then text = "格挡 " .. n(d.blocked) .. ((d.amount or 0) > 0 and "\n−" .. n(d.amount) or "") ink = C.block end
        text,ink=statusDamageLabel(d,text,ink)

        return text,ink
    end
    local function previousActor(old,d)
        local previous = old.player
        if d.target ~= "player" then for _, value in ipairs(old.enemies) do if value.id == d.target then previous = value break end end end
        return previous
    end
    local function playStep(d)
        local card = overlay:GetChild("playedCard")
        local definition = self.shadow.catalog.cards[d.cardId]
        local display = self.presentation[d.cardId]
        card:GetChild("name").text = display and display.name or definition.name
        tint(card:GetChild("plate"), C.cardType[definition.type] or C.panelRaised)
        card:GetChild("art"):SetImage(platform.imageSource, Theme.icon.cardArt[definition.type] or Theme.icon.cardArt.status)
        local targetsEnemy,area,attack=cardShape(definition)
        cardFlight(d,targetsEnemy,area)
        self.cardFlow:playing(d,self.flight)
        card:SetAnchoredPosition(self.flight.x, self.flight.y) card:SetLocalScale(1, 1, 1)
        card:SetVisible(true) overlay:SetAsLastSibling() sound("player_action")
        -- The traveler draws back while the card lifts, then leans in as it lands.
        local lift = T.base * T.anticipation
        self.poses.player = {age = 0, keys = attack
            and {{0, 0, 1}, {lift, -S.s, 1}, {T.base, S.l, 1}, {T.base + T.slow, 0, 1}}
            or {{0, 0, 1}, {T.base, 0, 1 + SWELL}, {T.base + T.slow, 0, 1}}}
    end
    local function bannerStep(d, kind)
        if kind == "enemy_turn" then banner("敌方回合") sound("turn")
        elseif kind == "player_turn" then banner("我方回合 " .. n(self.shadow.turn)) sound("turn")
        elseif kind == "victory" then banner(d.allEnemiesEscaped and "敌人已逃跑" or "战斗胜利") sound("victory")
        else
            banner("旅途暂歇", true)
            local shade = overlay:GetChild("deathShade")
            tint(shade, C.backdrop, 0)
            shade:SetVisible(true)
            if not self.deaths.player then sound("defeat") end
        end
    end
    local function silentIntent(a,d)
        local silent = not a or a.hp <= 0
        for _, intent in ipairs(a and a.intents or {}) do
            if intent.id == d.id then
                silent = silent or intent.kind == "sleep" or intent.kind == "stunned" or intent.kind == "escape"
                break
            end
        end
        return silent
    end
    local function intentStep(d, _kind, style)
        local a = actor(d.enemy)
        -- Actor identity belongs to the action, not each damage/status tick.
        local silent=silentIntent(a,d)
        local cue = a and a.definitionId and ("action_" .. a.definitionId)
        if not silent and Theme.sound[cue] then sound(cue) end
        stage:GetChild("notice").text = (a and a.name or "敌人") .. " · 正在行动"
        -- Windup fills the existing action gap; non-attacks rise instead of pulling back.
        local gather = T.enemyActionGap * (1 - T.anticipation)
        self.poses[d.enemy] = {age = 0, keys = style.attacks
            and {{0, 0, 1}, {gather, S.m, 1 + SWELL}, {T.enemyActionGap, S.m, 1 + SWELL}}
            or {{0, 0, 1}, {gather, 0, 1 + OVERSHOOT}, {T.enemyActionGap + T.slow, 0, 1}}}
    end
    local function escapeStep(d)
        local a = actor(d.enemy)
        stage:GetChild("notice").text = (a and a.name or "敌人") .. "正在逃离，已窃取的金币不会返还。"
        -- Dedicated escape hold. No death collapse, death cue or death flag.
        self.poses[d.enemy] = nil
    end
    local function deathStep(d)
        self.deaths[d.target] = true
        local _, box = actor(d.target)
        self.dying[d.target] = {age = 0}
        if box then
            box:SetVisible(true)
            box:GetChild("impact"):SetImage(platform.imageSource, Theme.image.diamond)
        end
        if not d.quiet then
            local victim = actor(d.target)
            sound(d.target == "player" and "defeat" or Theme.deathSound[victim and victim.definitionId] or "enemy_die")
        end
        if d.target == "player" then self.poses.player = nil overlay:SetAsLastSibling() end
    end
    local function damageText(d,kind,style)
        local text,ink=damageLabel(d)
        contactSound(d,style)
        if kind == "damage" and d.source and d.source ~= d.target then strike(d.source, style.stop or 0) end
        if style.form == "area" and style.hit == 1 then self.sweep = {age = 0} end

        return text,ink
    end
    local function statusText(d)
        local text,ink
        local status = self.shadow.catalog.statuses[d.status]
        text = (status and status.name or d.status) .. (d.amount >= 0 and " ＋" or " ") .. n(d.amount)
        if d.blockedStatus then
            local blocked = self.shadow.catalog.statuses[d.blockedStatus]
            text = "人工制品抵挡\n未施加" .. (blocked and blocked.name or timedLossNames[d.blockedStatus] or d.blockedStatus)
        end
        ink = status and status.kind == "buff" and C.buff or C.debuff
        sound("status")

        return text,ink
    end
    local function targetText(d,kind,style)
        local text, ink = "", C.goldBright
        if hurts(kind) then
            text, ink = damageText(d,kind,style)
        elseif kind == "block" then text, ink = "格挡 ＋" .. n(d.amount), C.block sound("block_gain")
        elseif kind == "status" then
            text, ink = statusText(d)
        elseif kind == "heal" then
            text, ink = "＋" .. n(d.amount), C.positive
            if (d.amount or 0) > 0 then sound("heal") end
        elseif kind == "gold_stolen" then text, ink = "失金 −" .. n(d.amount), C.goldBright end
        return text,ink
    end
    local function targetStep(d, kind, style, old)
        local a, box = actor(d.target)
        if box then
            local previous=previousActor(old,d)
            local text,ink=targetText(d,kind,style)
            if text ~= "" then
                local floating = box:GetChild("floating")
                floating.text, floating.fontColor = text, colour(ink)
                local icon = (kind == "status" or kind == "status_damage") and Theme.icon.status[d.status]
                box:GetChild("impact"):SetImage(platform.imageSource, icon or Theme.image.diamond)
                self.effects[d.target] = {kind = kind, age = 0, detail = d, ink = ink, style = style,
                    icon = icon and true or false, stop = style.stop or 0, dir = d.target == "player" and -1 or 1,
                    oldHp = previous.hp / previous.maxHp, hp = a.hp / a.maxHp}
            end
        end
    end
    local function startCast(d,kind,style)
        local family=style.family
        if family~='projectile' and family~='poison' and family~='bind' then return end
        local source=kind=='intent' and d.enemy or 'player'
        for i=self.index+1,#self.queue do
            local entry=self.queue[i]
            if entry.kind=='play' or entry.kind=='intent' or banners[entry.kind] then break end
            local detail=type(entry.detail)=='table' and entry.detail or {}
            if detail.target and detail.target~=source then
                local _,_,sx,sy=actor(source)
                local _,_,tx,ty=actor(detail.target)
                if sx and tx then self.cast={family=family,sx=sx,sy=sy,tx=tx,ty=ty,kind=kind} end
                return
            end
        end
    end
    local function enterFrame(entry, style)
        local old = self.shadow
        local nextView = {catalog = old.catalog, rules = old.rules}
        for k, v in pairs(entry.frame or old) do nextView[k] = v end
        -- Hold the played UID at contact until a committed frame names its pile.
        local landing = self.current and self.current.kind == "play" and entry.kind ~= "play"
        if self.current and self.current.kind == "enemy_escape" then self.escaping[self.current.detail.enemy] = nil end
        if entry.kind == "enemy_escape" then self.escaping[entry.detail.enemy] = true end
        self.shadow, self.current, self.style, self.elapsed = nextView, entry, style, 0
        self.cardFlow:sync(old,nextView,entry.kind)
        self.cardFlow:update(0,self.battle.catalog,self.presentation,self.fastMode)
        hideOverlay(landing or next(self.cardFlow.inPlay)~=nil)
        if landing then
            local card = overlay:GetChild("playedCard")
            card:SetAnchoredPosition(self.flight.tx, self.flight.ty) card:SetLocalScale(0.5, 0.5, 1)
            self.dissolve = nil
        end
        self.acting = entry.kind == "intent" and entry.detail.enemy or self.acting
        if entry.kind == "player_turn" then self.acting = nil end
        self.enemyRows=EnemyView.slots(self.shadow,self)
        present(self.shadow, self.acting, self.deaths)
        return old
    end
    local function step(entry, style)
        local old=enterFrame(entry,style)
        local d, kind = type(entry.detail) == "table" and entry.detail or {}, entry.kind
        print("ABYSS_FEEDBACK " .. kind .. " source=" .. tostring(d.source or d.enemy or "-") .. " target=" .. tostring(d.target or "-") .. " amount=" .. n(d.amount))
        if kind == "play" then
            playStep(d,kind,style,old)
            startCast(d,kind,style)
        elseif banners[kind] then
            bannerStep(d,kind,style,old)
        elseif kind == "intent" then
            intentStep(d,kind,style,old)
            startCast(d,kind,style)
        elseif kind == "enemy_escape" then
            escapeStep(d,kind,style,old)
        elseif kind == "death" or kind == "player_death" then
            deathStep(d,kind,style,old)
        elseif d.target then
            targetStep(d,kind,style,old)
        end
    end
    function self.start(_owner,before, battle, first, presentation, origin)
        -- GameActionManager releases its action gate independently of the
        -- dungeon's effectList. A subsequent card in this battle must not erase
        -- a previous target's still-running number, HP ghost or recovery pose.
        -- Cancellation, failure and battle replacement retain full cleanup.
        if self.battle ~= battle then self:reset() end
        self.battle = battle
        self.playbackFastMode = self.fastMode
        self.presentation, self.origin, self.acting = presentation, origin, nil
        self.shadow = {catalog = battle.catalog, rules = battle.rules}
        for k, v in pairs(before) do self.shadow[k] = v end
        self.deaths = {}
        for _, a in ipairs(before.enemies) do
            if a.hp <= 0 and not Actors.isPresent(a)then self.deaths[a.id] = true
            else self.dying[a.id] = nil end
        end
        self.queue, self.index, self.elapsed = {}, 0, 0
        local previous, area, pending, preDamageWait = before, false, {}, nil
        local function flush()
            -- Deaths read the latest frame so a deferred fade never rewinds later hits.
            -- Simultaneous kills collapse together: chained deaths start on consecutive frames, one cue.
            for i, id in ipairs(pending) do
                self.queue[#self.queue + 1] = {kind = "death", detail = {target = id, chained = i < #pending, quiet = i > 1}, frame = previous}
            end
            pending = {}
        end
        for i = first, #battle.events do
            local entry = battle.events[i]
            if entry.kind ~= "damage" then flush() end
            if entry.kind == "play" then
                area = false
                for _, effect in ipairs(battle.catalog.cards[entry.detail.cardId].effects) do area = area or effect.op == "damageAll" end
                -- Bludgeon.use queues zero-wait VFX, WaitAction(0.8), then damage.
                -- This is a presentation wait; committed core events stay untouched.
                preDamageWait = entry.detail.cardId == "bludgeon" and 0.8 or nil
            elseif entry.kind ~= "damage" then area = false end
            if entry.kind == "damage" and entry.detail.source == "player" and preDamageWait then
                self.queue[#self.queue + 1] = {kind = "action_wait", detail = {seconds = preDamageWait}, frame = previous}
                preDamageWait = nil
            end
            -- A committed defeat, not a transient zero-HP frame, owns player death.
            -- Revival can cross zero during damage without ending the battle.
            if entry.kind == "defeat" then
                self.queue[#self.queue + 1] = {kind = "player_death", detail = {target = "player"}, frame = previous}
            end
            self.queue[#self.queue + 1] = entry
            if entry.frame then
                local priorActors = {}
                for _, a in ipairs(previous.enemies) do priorActors[a.id] = a end
                for _, a in ipairs(entry.frame.enemies) do
                    local prior = priorActors[a.id]
                    if prior and Actors.isPresent(prior)and a.hp <= 0 and not Actors.isPresent(a)then pending[#pending + 1] = a.id end
                end
                previous = entry.frame
            end
            -- A single-target kill fades at once; an area sweep finishes the row first.
            if not area then flush() end
        end
        flush()
        self.styles = classify(self.queue, battle.catalog)
        for i, entry in ipairs(self.queue) do
            if entry.kind == "intent" then
                for j = i + 1, #self.queue do
                    local later = self.queue[j]
                    if later.kind == "intent" or banners[later.kind] then break end
                    if later.kind == "damage" and type(later.detail) == "table" and later.detail.source == entry.detail.enemy then
                        self.styles[i].attacks = true break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if #self.queue == 0 then finish() return end
        self.index = 1 step(self.queue[1], self.styles[1])
    end
    function self.update(_owner,dt)
        if not self.idleBattle and not self.busy and next(self.effects) == nil and next(self.poses) == nil and next(self.dying) == nil and not self.sweep and not self.dissolve and not self.cardFlow:busy() then return end
        local ok, failure = pcall(function()
            assert(type(dt) == "number" and dt == dt and dt >= 0 and dt < math.huge, "invalid frame delta")
            self.idleClock=ActorMotion.advance(self.idleClock or 0,dt,T.actorIdle)
            self.elapsed = (self.elapsed or 0) + dt
            if self.battle then self.cardFlow:update(dt,self.battle.catalog,self.presentation,self.fastMode)end
            -- At most one visible step per update: a stalled frame cannot skip an enemy turn.
            if self.busy and self.elapsed >= duration(self.current, self.style, self.playbackFastMode) then
                self.index = self.index + 1
                local entry = self.queue[self.index]
                if not entry then finish() return end
                step(entry, self.styles[self.index])
            end
            if self.busy and self.current.kind == "play" then
                -- Lift and gather, then accelerate into the target: arrival is the contact frame.
                local p, lift = clamp(self.elapsed / T.base), T.anticipation
                local card, f = overlay:GetChild("playedCard"), self.flight
                if p < lift then
                    local q = easeOut(p / lift)
                    card:SetAnchoredPosition(f.x, f.y + S.l * q)
                    card:SetLocalScale(1 + q * OVERSHOOT, 1 + q * OVERSHOOT, 1)
                else
                    local q = easeIn((p - lift) / (1 - lift))
                    local s = (1 + OVERSHOOT) * (1 - q) + q / 2
                    card:SetAnchoredPosition(f.x + (f.tx - f.x) * q, f.y + S.l + (f.ty - f.y - S.l) * q)
                    card:SetLocalScale(s, s, 1)
                end
            end
            if self.busy and banners[self.current.kind] then
                -- Slide in, hold, slide out; the plate wipes open before the text arrives.
                local age, travel = self.elapsed, S.xxl * 2
                local enter, exit = easeOut(age / T.fast), easeIn((age - T.banner + T.fast) / T.fast)
                local label, plate = overlay:GetChild("banner"), overlay:GetChild("bannerPlate")
                label:SetAnchoredPosition(-travel * (1 - enter) + travel * exit, S.xxl)
                label.fontColor = colour(self.bannerInk, enter * (1 - exit))
                plate:SetLocalScale(1, enter * (1 - exit), 1)
                if self.current.kind == "defeat" then
                    tint(overlay:GetChild("deathShade"), C.backdrop, easeIn(age / T.banner))
                end
            end
            if self.dissolve then
                self.dissolve = self.dissolve + dt
                local p, card = clamp(self.dissolve / T.fast), overlay:GetChild("playedCard")
                card:SetVisible(p < 1)
                card:SetLocalScale((1 - easeOut(p)) / 2, (1 - easeOut(p)) / 2, 1)
                if p >= 1 then self.dissolve = nil end
            end
            if self.sweep then
                self.sweep.age = self.sweep.age + dt
                local p = clamp(self.sweep.age / T.base)
                local sweep = overlay:GetChild("sweep")
                sweep.localRotationZ=0
                sweep:SetAnchoredPosition(ROW,L.enemyRow.y)
                sweep:SetVisible(p < 1)
                sweep:SetLocalScale(easeOut(p), 1 - p / 2, 1)
                tint(sweep, C.geo, 1 - easeIn(p))
                if p >= 1 then self.sweep = nil end
            end
            if self.cast then
                local cast=self.cast
                local total=cast.kind=='play' and T.base or T.enemyActionGap
                local p=clamp(self.elapsed/total)
                local x,y,alpha=SkillFeedback.travel(cast.family,p,cast.sx,cast.sy,cast.tx,cast.ty)
                local sweep=overlay:GetChild('sweep')
                sweep:SetVisible(alpha>0)
                sweep:SetAnchoredPosition(x,y)
                sweep:SetLocalScale(S.xl/(L.enemyRow.xTo-L.enemyRow.xFrom+L.enemyRow.bossPortrait),0.5,1)
                sweep.localRotationZ=cast.family=='bind' and p*180 or 0
                tint(sweep,cast.family=='poison' and C.positive or cast.family=='bind' and C.debuff or C.block,alpha)
            end
            local shakes, ids = {}, {}
            if self.idleBattle and self.shadow then
                if self.shadow.player.hp>0 then ids.player=true end
                for _,unit in ipairs(self.shadow.enemies)do if Actors.isPresent(unit) then ids[unit.id]=true end end
            end
            for id in pairs(self.poses) do ids[id] = true end
            for id in pairs(self.effects) do ids[id] = true end
            for id in pairs(self.dying) do ids[id] = true end
            -- A newly entered player death starts now, not at the beginning of a stalled frame.
            local effectDt = self.current and self.current.kind == "player_death" and math.min(dt, self.elapsed) or dt
            for id in pairs(ids) do ActorPainter.paint(painter,id,effectDt,shakes) end
            local shake = 0
            for _, value in ipairs(shakes) do if math.abs(value) > math.abs(shake) then shake = value end end
            if self.stageShake ~= shake then
                stage:SetAnchoredPosition(shake, 0)
                self.stageShake = shake
            end
        end)
        if not ok then finish(failure) end
    end
    function self.setFastMode(owner, enabled)
        assert(type(enabled) == "boolean", "fast mode must be boolean")
        owner.fastMode = enabled
    end
    -- Called only after the rule transaction; even start/control failure must unlock.
    function self.begin(_owner,...)
        -- Own completion before reset/queue preparation can fail or find no events.
        self.busy = true
        local ok, failure = pcall(self.start, self, ...)
        if not ok then finish(failure) end
    end
    return self
end
return M

local MonsterArt=require('abyss_monster_art')
-- Composes committed actor feedback into native portrait/effect controls only.
-- Queue timing, completion and battle ownership remain with abyss_feedback.
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local ActorMotion = require("abyss_actor_motion")
local SkillFeedback = require("abyss_skill_feedback")
local M = {}
local T,C,L,S = Theme.motion,Theme.color,Theme.layout,Theme.space
local OVERSHOOT,FLASH = 1/3,0.85
local function clamp(x) return x < 0 and 0 or x > 1 and 1 or x end
local function easeOut(x) x=clamp(x) return 1-(1-x)*(1-x) end
local function easeIn(x) x=clamp(x) return x*x end
local function hurts(kind) return kind=="damage" or kind=="hp_loss" or kind=="status_damage" end
local function mix(a,b,w) return {r=a.r+(b.r-a.r)*w,g=a.g+(b.g-a.g)*w,b=a.b+(b.b-a.b)*w,a=a.a} end
local function colour(ctx,c,alpha) return ctx.platform.color(c.r,c.g,c.b,math.floor((c.a or 255)*(alpha or 1))) end
local function tint(ctx,box,c,alpha) box.imageColor=colour(ctx,c,alpha) end
-- Piecewise pose: {time, x, scale} keys with smooth in/out between them.
local function pose(keys, age)
    if age >= keys[#keys][1] then return keys[#keys][2], keys[#keys][3], true end
    for i = 2, #keys do
        local a, b = keys[i - 1], keys[i]
        if age < b[1] then
            local p = b[1] > a[1] and (age - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1]) or 1
            p = p * p * (3 - 2 * p)
            return a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * p, a[3] + (b[3] - a[3]) * p, false
        end
    end
end

-- Per-actor composition: attacker pose + victim knockback/flash + death collapse, applied once.
local function appendShake(id,sample,shakes)
    local age,d,style,heavy=sample.age,sample.detail,sample.style,sample.heavy
    if id == "player" or heavy or style.lethal then
        local scale = math.min(1, ((d.amount or 0) + (d.blocked or 0)) / T.heavyHitDamage)
        local amplitude = T.shakeAmplitude * (id == "player" and (scale + 1) / 2 or scale / 2)
        if age < T.shake then shakes[#shakes + 1] = amplitude * (1 - age / T.shake) * math.sin(age / T.shake * math.pi * 4) end
    end
end
local function paintKnockback(effect,sample,x,y)
    local age,d,style,kind=sample.age,sample.detail,sample.style,sample.kind
    local after,frozen,lost,heavy=sample.after,sample.frozen,sample.lost,sample.heavy
    -- Knockback snaps out on contact, holds through the hit-stop, then eases home.
    if lost and kind == "damage" then
        local reach = heavy and S.l or style.form == "area" and S.s or S.m
        local out = frozen and 1 or 1 - easeOut(after / T.base)
        x = x + effect.dir * reach * out
        if style.form == "multi" then y = y + (style.hit % 2 == 0 and S.xs or -S.xs) * out end
    elseif lost and style.form == "dot" and d.status ~= "poison" then
        x = x + effect.dir * S.xs * (1 - easeOut(age / T.fast))
    end
    return x,y
end
local function paintMotion(id,effect,sample,shakes,x,y,ink,flash)
    local age,kind=sample.age,sample.kind
    local after,frozen,lost=sample.after,sample.frozen,sample.lost
    x,y=paintKnockback(effect,sample,x,y)
    if lost then
        flash = frozen and 1 or math.max(0, 1 - after / T.fast)
        ink = kind == "damage" and (id == "player" and C.danger or C.goldBright) or kind == "hp_loss" and C.danger or C.debuff
        appendShake(id,sample,shakes)
    elseif kind == "status" or kind == "heal" then
        flash = math.max(0, 1 - age / T.fast) / 2
        ink = effect.ink
    end
    return x,y,ink,flash
end
local function impactShape(effect,sample,e)
    local age,style,kind,heavy=sample.age,sample.style,sample.kind,sample.heavy
    local ix, iy
    local iy0 = 0
    if effect.icon then
        local stamp = kind == "status" and 1 + (1 - easeOut(age / T.fast)) * OVERSHOOT * 2 or 1 - OVERSHOOT + e * OVERSHOOT
        ix, iy = stamp, stamp
        if kind == "status" then iy0 = (effect.ink == C.buff and 1 or -1) * S.m * easeOut((age - T.fast) / (T.slow - T.fast)) end
    elseif heavy then ix, iy = 1 + e, 1 + e
    elseif style.form == "area" then ix, iy = 1.5 + e / 2, 0.2
    elseif style.form == "multi" and style.hit % 2 == 0 then ix, iy = 0.3 * (1 - e) + 0.1, 1.2 + e / 2
    else ix, iy = 1.2 + e / 2, 0.3 * (1 - e) + 0.1 end
    return ix,iy,iy0
end
local function impactTint(id,effect,sample,e)
    local kind,age=sample.kind,sample.age
    local shardInk = effect.icon and effect.ink or id == "player" and C.text or C.geo
    local alpha=(effect.icon and kind == "status" and math.min(1, 2 - 2 * easeIn(age / T.slow)) or 1 - e)
    return shardInk,alpha
end
local function skillImpact(effect,sample,e)
    local family,form=effect.style.family,effect.style.form
    if not effect.icon and family~='none'
        and ((form~='multi' and form~='area')or(family~='melee' and family~='heavy'))then
        return SkillFeedback.sample(family,e,S.m)
    end
    local ix,iy,iy0=impactShape(effect,sample,e)
    return ix,iy,0,iy0
end
local function paintImpact(ctx,id,impact,effect,sample)
    local age,kind=sample.age,sample.kind
    local after,frozen,lost,heavy=sample.after,sample.frozen,sample.lost,sample.heavy
    -- Geo shard: one diamond image, shaped by non-uniform scale per attack form.
    local window = effect.icon and T.slow or heavy and T.base or T.fast
    local e = frozen and 0 or easeOut(after / window)
    local show = (lost or kind == "status") and age < effect.stop + window
    impact:SetVisible(show)
    if show then
        local ix,iy,offset,iy0,alpha,key=skillImpact(effect,sample,e)
        impact:SetLocalScale(ix, iy, 1)
        impact:SetAnchoredPosition(offset or 0, iy0)
        local shardInk,shardAlpha=impactTint(id,effect,sample,e)
        tint(ctx,impact,key and C[key] or shardInk,alpha or shardAlpha)
    end
    return window
end
local function paintShield(ctx,box,shield,sample)
    local age,kind,d=sample.age,sample.kind,sample.detail
    local lost=sample.lost
    -- Shield: crystallises in on gain, shudders when it holds, shatters when it breaks.
    local blocked = (d.blocked or 0) > 0
    local guard = kind == "block" or blocked
    shield:SetVisible(guard and age < T.slow)
    if guard and age < T.slow then
        local scale, wobble = 1, 0
        local fade
        if kind == "block" then
            scale = 1 + (1 - easeOut(age / T.fast)) * OVERSHOOT
            fade = age < T.fast and easeOut(age / T.fast) or 1 - easeIn((age - T.fast) / (T.slow - T.fast))
        elseif lost then
            scale, fade = 1 + easeOut(age / T.fast) / 2, math.max(0, 1 - age / T.fast)
        else
            wobble = S.xs * math.sin(age / T.fast * math.pi * 3) * math.max(0, 1 - age / T.fast)
            fade = 1 - easeIn(age / T.slow)
        end
        shield:SetLocalScale(scale, scale, 1) shield:SetAnchoredPosition(wobble, 0)
        tint(ctx,shield, C.block, fade)
        local pop = 1 + (1 - easeOut(age / T.base)) * OVERSHOOT
        -- Keep the badge inside its reserved horizontal lane beside HP and neighbouring units.
        for _, part in ipairs({"blockEdge", "blockIcon", "block"}) do box:GetChild(part):SetLocalScale(1, pop, 1) end
    end
end
local function numberScale(sample)
    local heavy,lost,frozen,after=sample.heavy,sample.lost,sample.frozen,sample.after
    local peak = heavy and lost and 2 or lost and 1.5 or 1.25
    local scale = frozen and peak or 1 + (peak - 1) * (1 - easeOut(after / T.fast))
    return scale
end
local function paintNumber(ctx,id,box,effect,sample,window)
    local age,style=sample.age,sample.style
    -- Number: pops on contact, holds through the hit-stop, settles, rises and fades.
    local p = clamp(age / T.damagePop)
    local floating = box:GetChild("floating")
    floating:SetVisible(p < 1)
    local drift = style.form == "multi" and (style.hit % 2 == 1 and -S.m or S.m) or 0
    floating:SetAnchoredPosition(drift, L.enemyRow.portrait / 2 + S.xl * easeOut(p))
    floating.fontColor = colour(ctx,effect.ink, p < 0.5 and 1 or 2 - 2 * p)
    local scale=numberScale(sample)
    floating:SetLocalScale(scale, scale, 1)
    local ghost = clamp((age - T.hpGhostDelay) / T.hpGhost)
    box:GetChild("hpGhost").fillAmount = effect.oldHp + (effect.hp - effect.oldHp) * ghost
    if age >= math.max(T.damagePop, T.hpGhostDelay + T.hpGhost, effect.stop + window) then
        ctx.state.effects[id] = nil
        for _, part in ipairs({"blockEdge", "blockIcon", "block"}) do box:GetChild(part):SetLocalScale(1, 1, 1) end
        box:GetChild("impact"):SetLocalScale(1, 1, 1)
    end
end
local function paintDying(ctx,id,box,dt,y,sx,sy,ink,flash,alpha)
    local dying = ctx.state.dying[id]
    if dying then
        -- Gleam, then the figure crumbles into the ground as a shard burst disperses.
        dying.age = dying.age + dt
        local p = clamp(dying.age / T.slow)
        ink, flash, alpha = id == "player" and C.danger or C.goldBright, 1 - easeOut(p), 1 - easeIn(p)
        sx, sy = sx * (1 + p * OVERSHOOT), sy * (1 - easeIn(p) / 2)
        y = y - S.m * easeIn(p)
        local impact = box:GetChild("impact")
        impact:SetVisible(p < 1) impact:SetAnchoredPosition(0, 0)
        impact:SetLocalScale(1 + easeOut(p), 1 + easeOut(p), 1)
        tint(ctx,impact, id == "player" and C.danger or C.geo, (1 - p) * 0.8)
        box:SetVisible(p < 1)
        if p >= 1 then ctx.state.dying[id] = nil end
    end
    return y,sx,sy,ink,flash,alpha
end
function M.paint(ctx,id, dt, shakes)
    local unit, box = ctx.actor(id)
    if not box then ctx.state.effects[id], ctx.state.poses[id], ctx.state.dying[id] = nil, nil, nil return end
    local base = id == "player" and C.geo or C.text
    local ink, flash, alpha = base, 0, 1
    local posed = ctx.state.poses[id]
    local motionState=ActorMotion.state(unit,posed,ctx.state.effects[id],ctx.state.dying[id],ctx.state.escaping[id])
    local x,y,sx,sy=ActorMotion.idle(unit,id,ctx.state.idleClock or 0,motionState,T.actorIdle)
    if posed then
        posed.age = posed.age + dt
        local px, ps, done = pose(posed.keys, posed.age)
        if motionState=='action' then x, sx, sy = px, ps, ps end
        if done then ctx.state.poses[id] = nil end
    end
    local effect = ctx.state.effects[id]
    if effect then
        effect.age = effect.age + dt
        local sample={age=effect.age,detail=effect.detail,style=effect.style,kind=effect.kind,
            after=math.max(0,effect.age-effect.stop),frozen=effect.age<effect.stop,
            lost=hurts(effect.kind) and (effect.detail.amount or 0)>0,heavy=effect.style.weight=='heavy'}
        local impact,shield=box:GetChild('impact'),box:GetChild('shield')
        x,y,ink,flash=paintMotion(id,effect,sample,shakes,x,y,ink,flash)
        local window=paintImpact(ctx,id,impact,effect,sample)
        paintShield(ctx,box,shield,sample)
        paintNumber(ctx,id,box,effect,sample,window)
    end
    y,sx,sy,ink,flash,alpha=paintDying(ctx,id,box,dt,y,sx,sy,ink,flash,alpha)
    local portrait = box:GetChild("portrait")
    portrait:SetAnchoredPosition(x, y)
    portrait:SetLocalScale(sx, sy, 1)
    if id == "player" and ctx.platform.portraits then ctx.platform.portraits:battlePose(x,y,sx,sy) end
    local tone=flash > 0 and mix(base,ink,flash*FLASH) or base
    tint(ctx,portrait,tone,alpha)
    MonsterArt.pose(box,x,y,sx,sy,tone,alpha)
end
return M

-- Fixed 319009 Focus/Bias rules. Player statuses are the only numeric truth.
local Events=require('abyss_events')
local M={}
local function integer(n) return type(n)=='number' and n==math.floor(n) and math.abs(n)<=2147483647 end
local templates={
    focus={name='集中',kind='buff',description='每层提高闪电球伤害、冰霜球格挡和黑暗球的储伤增长；负层数降低这些数值，等离子球的能量不受影响'},
    bias={name='偏差',kind='debuff',description='每个你的回合开始，失去与层数相同的集中；每次失去可由一层人工制品抵挡'},
}
local function definition(id)
    local out={id=id,stack='intensity',decay='none'}
    for k,v in pairs(templates[id]) do out[k]=v end
    return out
end
local function complete(def,id)
    for k,v in pairs(templates[id]) do if def[k]==nil then def[k]=v end end
end
function M.ensureDefinitions(state)
    local defs=assert(state.catalog and state.catalog.statuses,'missing status catalog')
    for _,id in ipairs({'focus','bias'}) do
        if defs[id] then
            assert(defs[id].id==id and defs[id].stack=='intensity' and defs[id].decay=='none','incompatible '..id..' definition')
        else defs[id]=definition(id) end
        complete(defs[id],id)
        for _,actor in ipairs({state.player}) do
            if actor.statusDefinitions and actor.statusDefinitions~=defs then
                if not actor.statusDefinitions[id] then actor.statusDefinitions[id]=definition(id) end
                complete(actor.statusDefinitions[id],id)
            end
        end
    end
end
function M.value(state)
    local value=state.player.statuses.focus
    assert(value==nil or integer(value),'invalid focus')
    return value or 0
end
function M.sync(state)
    local value=M.value(state)
    if state.orbs then state.orbs.focus=value end
    return value
end
function M.remove(state)
    local player=state.player
    if not require('abyss_actor').isActive(player) then return false end
    if player.statuses.focus==nil then M.sync(state);return false end
    local before=player.statuses.focus
    player.statuses.focus=nil
    M.sync(state)
    Events.emit(state,'status_removed',{source=player.id,target=player.id,status='focus',amount=-before})
    return true
end
function M.apply(state,actor,amount,source)
    local Actors=require('abyss_actor')
    if not Actors.isActive(actor) then return false end
    assert(integer(amount),'invalid focus amount')
    M.ensureDefinitions(state)
    local before=actor.statuses.focus
    assert(before==nil or integer(before),'invalid focus')
    if amount<=0 and Actors.tryBlockDebuff(state,actor,'focus') then return false end
    local value=amount
    if before~=nil then
        -- Arithmetic is binary64 before source clamp, not Fengari signed32 wrap.
        value=math.max(-999,math.min(999,before+0.0+amount))
    end
    actor.statuses.focus=value
    if actor==state.player then M.sync(state) end
    Events.emit(state,'status',{source=(source or actor).id,target=actor.id,status='focus',amount=value-(before or 0)})
    -- Source queues TOP removal at exact-zero stack. Current action boundary
    -- has no intervening callbacks, so remove before the next mapped action.
    if before~=nil and value==0 then
        if actor==state.player then M.remove(state)
        else
            actor.statuses.focus=nil
            Events.emit(state,'status_removed',{source=actor.id,target=actor.id,status='focus',amount=0})
        end
    end
    return true
end
function M.startTurn(state,_api)
    local Actors=require('abyss_actor')
    if not Actors.isActive(state.player) then return false end
    local bias=state.player.statuses.bias or 0
    assert(integer(bias) and bias>=0,'invalid bias')
    if bias==0 then return false end
    -- One incoming negative Power per tick, even if Bias has multiple stacks.
    return Actors.applyPower(state,state.player,'focus',-bias,state.player)
end
return M
